title_en: Portable tvws (tv white space) integrated battery pack for disaster response and military tactical operations
title_ko: 재난 및 군 전술 작전을 위한 장병 휴대용 tvws 통합 배터리 팩
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 및 군 전술 작전을 위한 장병 휴대용 TVWS 통합 배터리 팩에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 다수의 군사장비를 동시에 운용하는 환경에서 전력 제어와 TVWS(TV White Space) 기반 무선 통신을 통합하여, 안정적 전력 공급과 실시간 지휘 통신을 동시에 수행하는데 있다. 
일례로, 전력을 저장하고 일정 전압으로 변환하여 출력하며, 통신 신호와 통합된 전력 신호를 단일 케이블을 통해 다수의 군사장비로 전달하는 전력 공급부; 상기 전력 공급부의 출력을 제어하고, 각 군사장비에 전력을 분배하며, BMS(Battery Management System)와 NMS(Network Management System)를 기반으로 전력 상태와 통신 상태를 감시하는 전력 제어부; 상기 전력 공급부와 상기 전력 제어부의 제어 하에 전력 신호와 데이터 신호를 통합하여 전송하며, TVWS(TV White Space) 기반 무선 네트워크를 통해 외부 지휘체계 서버와 양방향 통신을 수행하는 무선 연동부를 포함하는 재난 및 군 전술 작전을 위한 장병 휴대용 TVWS 통합 배터리 팩을 개시한다.
assignees: BATTERY POWER SOLUTIONS;NZIA CONNECT INC;KIM YU SEOK

title_en: Intelligent vehicle operation management system in field of ocean engineering construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle intelligent operation management system in the field of ocean engineering construction, which relates to the field of vehicle operation management and comprises a vehicle intelligent operation management platform, a work order generation module, a driver execution module and a site regulation and control module, wherein the work order generation module analyzes the vehicle use condition of an engineering project and generates a work order list, the driver order receiving module is used for receiving orders and executing tasks for allocation tasks in the work order generation module, and the site recording module regulates and controls the vehicle use according to the actual condition of a construction site. According to the invention, the vehicle dispatcher, the on-site driver and the on-site responsible person are connected, the vehicle requirements of the construction task and the vehicle information are combined, the construction vehicle is precisely allocated, the vehicle is reasonably regulated and controlled in real time, an intelligent information interaction platform is constructed, the real-time monitoring of the vehicle state, the dynamic matching of the transportation requirements and the precise issuing of the dispatching instructions are realized, and the transfer efficiency and the resource coordination level of the ocean engineering equipment are effectively improved.
assignees: COOEC FLUOR HEAVY IND CO LTD

title_en: Processing method, architecture, device, equipment and storage medium for work order delivery
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a processing method, a framework, a device, equipment and a storage medium for work order delivery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the first server side sends work order information to the first terminal; receiving test data which is transmitted by the first terminal and corresponds to the work order information and passes verification; and sending the test data to a second service end, so that the second service end sends the test data to a second terminal and receives client return visit information sent by the second terminal, wherein the client return visit information is used for indicating whether to confirm the test data. Therefore, the embodiment of the application can solve the problems that in the prior art, the work order delivery needs to be processed by clients and delivery personnel at the same time on the delivery site, and the coordination difficulty of the delivery process is high, so that the work order delivery is difficult to comprehensively manage.

title_en: Smart city management and scheduling platform system
abstract_en: A smart city management and scheduling platform system, comprising: a front-end monitoring data acquisition module, a cloud platform server, a command and control system, and multiple registered law enforcement mobile terminals. The front-end monitoring data acquisition module sends to the cloud platform server and the command and control system acquired image, audio, and video data in a real-time manner. The cloud platform server is configured to access, store, and analyze the received image, audio, and video data, back up preset data independently, and send the same to a related client end or a linked front-end or back-end alarm device. The command and control system is configured to review the received image, audio, and video data, and exchange data with the registered law enforcement mobile terminals. The system enables coordination between mobile terminals and intercom terminals, video scheduling, and location-based coordination and scheduling, and achieves centralized management of all user terminals at different locations and in different networks.
assignees: SHENZHEN SINOEXPO GAOKE PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Interactive wireless life safety communications system
abstract_en: An interactive wireless life safety communications system is disclosed. A central coordination server is linked to a first network, over which there is a connection to at least one resident life safety device at a specific location or for specific resident. An alarm signal is generated by the resident life safety device upon detection of an alarm condition and transmitted to the central coordination server. A caregiver communications device is connected to the central coordination server over a second network, and is receptive to an alarm notification that is generated by the central coordination server in response to the alarm signal. The caregiver communications device is also receptive to a caregiver user input, from which an action status response is generated for transmission to the central coordination server.

title_en: System and method for constructing of respose on disaster based on scenario
title_ko: 시나리오 기반 재난 대응 구축 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system to construct a disaster response based on a scenario. The system to construct a disaster response based on a scenario comprises: a scenario planning unit that a user logs in and configures a simulation environment to simulate a scenario by disaster type; a disaster type-based scenario generation unit to generate a scenario in accordance with the user conditions and the simulation environment configured by the scenario planning unit, wherein the scenario is generated by combining a standard operation procedure (SOP) corresponding to a disaster management step by disaster type, emergency support function and geographic information; a simulation unit to execute a simulation to realize a scenario with respect to the disaster type-based scenario generated by the scenario generation unit, generate an emergency warning along the scenario, distribute response resources in accordance with a crisis situation, manage a command system and recover the disaster situation; a post-event analysis unit to generate user assessment data in accordance with the simulated results, generate and store a report; and a disaster variable introduction unit to search not only analyzed disaster variables but also disaster type-based disaster variables from a variety of internet webpages using a web robot module and provide the searched disaster variables to the scenario generation unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 시나리오 기반 재난 대응 구축 시스템에 대한 것으로, 재난 유형별로 시나리오를 시뮬레이션하기 위해서 사용자가 로그인하고 시뮬레이션 환경을 설정하기 위한 시나리오 플래닝부; 상기 시나리오 플래닝부에 의하여 설정된 사용자 조건과 시뮬레이션 환경에 따라 시나리오를 생성하되, 재난 유형에 따라 재난 처리 단계에 해당하는 표준 운영 절차(SOP)와, 긴급 지원 기능 자원과, 지리 정보를 조합하여 시나리오를 생성하는 재난 유형별 시나리오 생성부; 상기 시나리오 생성부에서 생성된 재난 유형별 시나리오에 대하여 시나리오를 구현하고 상기 시나리오 진행에 따라 위기 발생 경보를 발생하며, 위기 상황에 따른 우선 순위에 따라서 대응 자원을 배분하고 지휘체계를 관리하여 재난 상황을 복구 처리하도록 시뮬레이션을 실행하는 시뮬레이션부; 상기 시뮬레이션 진행결과에 따라서 사용자 평가 자료를 생성하고 결과 보고서를 생성하여 저장하는 사후분석부; 및 조사분석된 재난 변수 뿐만 아니라 웹 로봇모듈에 의하여 다양한 인터넷 사이트로부터 재난 유형별로 재난 변수를 검색하고 상기 검색된 재난 변수를 상기 시나리오 생성부로 제공하는 재난변수 도입부를 포함한다.

title_en: Simulation training and evaluation system for fire fighting activity on-scene command system
title_ko: 소방활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 및 평가 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 현장지휘관이 화재유형별로 소방활동을 지휘하는 훈련을 시뮬레이션을 통해 수행하고 이를 평가하여 관리할 수 있도록 하는 소방활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 및 평가 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 소방활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 및 평가 시스템은 소방 지휘관이 개인 단말기를 통해 소방활동 현장지휘체계 훈련을 수행하고 평가받을 수 있도록 하는 소방활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 및 평가 시스템으로서,  
현장지휘관이 개인 단말기를 통해 교육 훈련을 할 수 있도록 화재유형별 화재상황의 훈련 시나리오를 편집하여 시뮬레이션 훈련 콘텐츠를 구현하는 시나리오 편집 서버(100)와; 상기 시나리오 편집 서버(100)에 의해 구현된 시뮬레이션 훈련 콘텐츠를 통하여 개인 단말기로 훈련을 수행하는 현장지휘관의 훈련 결과를 평가 관리하는 LMS(Learning Management System) 서버(200)와; 상기 시나리오 편집 서버(100) 및 LMS 서버(200)를 통하여 생성되는 데이터를 저장하고 관리하는 훈련 평가 데이터베이스 서버(300);를 포함하되, 상기 LMS 서버(200)는 훈련 평가 데이터베이스 서버(200)와 연동되어 화재유형별 소방 활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 콘텐츠와 연동이 가능하며, 훈련 내용 및 사용자 정보를 Web을 통해 조회 및 수정, 삭제할 수 있도록 제공된다.

title_en: System and method for task-based marketplace platform
abstract_en: The embodiments herein provides a computer-implemented system and method for facilitating on-demand task assignment and management in a distributed network. The system dynamically connects task requesters with service providers through an algorithmic matching engine that evaluates factors such as skills, location, availability, and reputation. A bidding mechanism allows service providers to compete for tasks, while an integrated escrow-based payment system ensures secure transactions. The platform further incorporates a reputation management system with user ratings and verification features to enhance trust and reliability. By automating task posting, matching, scheduling, and payment processing, the invention optimizes efficiency, transparency, and scalability in peer-to-peer task outsourcing. The system is accessible via web and mobile interfaces, enabling real-time coordination between users across diverse geographic locations.

title_en: Task tracking management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task tracking management system, which comprises a task dispatching module, a task tracking module and a task tracking module, wherein a manager dispatches tasks and appoints an executor; the task reassigning module is used for executing the tasks by the executor or reassigning the tasks to the executor at the next stage when the tasks are assigned to the executor, so that the step-by-step or skip-by-step assignment is realized; the task reminding module is used for reminding the executor to complete and submit the task in a short message mode automatically when the preset advance reminding time point of the task is reached; the task auditing module is used for auditing the dispatched task nodes step by step in the auditing process and returning to the task initiator for approval confirmation; the task tracking module can check the task flow situation at any time after assigning the task and master the whole task flow according to the flow time node; the problem of confusion and repeated labor in the management of the engineering project of the power grid company is solved; in the process work, the coordination is disordered, and a task scheduler cannot track the execution and completion conditions of the tasks in time.

title_en: Information system operation maintenance service supervision optimization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information system operation maintenance service supervision optimization system, which relates to the field of service supervision and comprises an operation maintenance service supervision platform, wherein an information system management module, a data acquisition module, a data verification module, a supervision coordination module, a data analysis module and a supervision optimization module are arranged in the operation maintenance service supervision platform; the system comprises an information system management module, a data acquisition module, a data verification module, a supervision coordination module, a data analysis module and a supervision optimization module, wherein the information system management module is used for inputting system information and historical service work order data and constructing an operation and maintenance service association diagram, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring work order monitoring data, the data verification module is used for verifying the work order monitoring data according to the operation and maintenance service association diagram to generate work order data packets, the supervision coordination module is used for carrying out coordination allocation on data processing resources according to the work order data packets, the data analysis module is used for carrying out analysis on the work order data packets to generate operation and maintenance monitoring data according to analysis results, and the supervision optimization module is used for carrying out optimization processing on service work order data according to the operation and maintenance monitoring data.
assignees: NANJING CHENGQUAN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multilevel Assignment of Jobs and Tasks in Online Work Management System
abstract_en: An online work management system provides a marketplace for multiple job owner and workers. The job owners provide a job description that defines task. The job description may be processed to generate task descriptions that may be published for workers' application. The task descriptions specify the qualification or restrictions for workers to have the task assigned. The online work management system also provides various functions supporting coordination and management of task assignment such as determining the trust level of the user's identity, search the tasks or workers, monitoring the progress of job, managing payment to workers, training and testing the workers, evaluating the review by the job owners, and generation of surveys.

title_en: Automatic distribution method and system for gynecological nursing tasks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource scheduling, in particular to an automatic distribution method and system for gynecological nursing tasks, comprising the following steps of acquiring task data and counting intensive grades, and extracting action information and patient state, judging task executability, generating personnel capability mapping by combining the completion condition and the shift task quantity, and generating an automatic allocation scheme according to the priority and the personnel number. According to the invention, through multidimensional extraction and association analysis of task density, operation elements, patient states and personnel performances, accurate identification of task execution conditions and operation adaptation grading are realized, action sequencing and matching assignment are completed by combining personnel capacity and task priority, the degree of fit between tasks and personnel and feasibility of path execution in the assignment process are enhanced, the task completion efficiency and stability are improved, and the response speed of nursing task assignment, the reasonable degree of resource utilization and the coordination level of the whole flow are further promoted.

title_en: Automatic optimization control method and system for operator network entire process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic optimization control method and system for an operator network entire process, and relates to the field of construction, traffic maintenance and routing inspection of mobile communication networks. First, construction control is conducted, wherein an indoor coverage network access application work order is established when a base station is constructed, building information input and generation of a test task are performed according to building names in the work order, the quality of building networks is tested according to the test task, and a test result is uploaded; after construction control is completed, a building traffic maintenance work order is generated for buildings with access to the networks, and the building networks are maintained according to the building traffic maintenance work order; finally, an inspection plan is made according to the base station and building data, inspection of the quality of the building networks is performed according to the inspection plan, the quality of the buildings is assessed according to an inspection result, and therefore the routing inspection process is completed. According to the automatic optimization control method and system for the operator network entire process, control over the process is performed through comprehensive essential data, so that the entire process is traceable; meanwhile, coordination work between all departments is reinforced through electronic management, so that work efficiency is improved.

title_en: Esi map service apparatus for hns spill response
title_ko: 위험유해물질 방제정보지도 제공 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 해안선의 유형, 프랙탈 차원 및 파랑 정보를 통합하여 해안선의 환경민감도 지수를 도출하여 위험유해물질(HNS: Hazard and Noxious Substance)의 유출 시 우선 방제 대상 지역을 설정하여 방제를 수행할 수 있도록 하는 것에 의해 해양 HNS 오염 사고에 대한 효율적인 방제를 수행할 수 있도록 하는 위험유해물질 방제정보지도 제공 장치에 관한 것이다. 
접속된 사용자에게 방제정보지도제공 인터페이스를 제공하여 상호작용을 수행하며 방제정보지도를 제공하는 방제정보지도제공부; 및 방제정보지도 제작을 위한 지휘체계 및 연락처체계 정보와, 환경정보와, 지도 및 위성 영상 정보와, 방제지침정보와, 해안선정보와, 민감자원정보와, 방제자원정보와, 물자보급정보를 저장하여 방제정보지도제공부로 제공하는 데이터베이스를 저장하는 저장부;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Intelligent manufacturing MES system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent manufacturing MES system, which comprises a production scheduling module, a work order issuing module, a work order coordination module, a work order execution module, a production control module, a production monitoring module, a data acquisition module, equipment management, quality process control, monitoring information release, production management and a production report And (5) zooming out and hiding.

title_en: Coal yard safety equipment management method and system based on environment monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal yard safety management and environment monitoring, and discloses a coal yard safety equipment management method and system based on environment monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting environment data and equipment running state data in real time; generating an environment-running state-equipment association data set, eliminating interference data caused by production stoppage maintenance and operation planning, carrying out abnormal marking on data exceeding a preset safety threshold at any point in the association data set, carrying out risk index calculation on the abnormally marked data to obtain a risk index, generating a safety equipment action list based on a risk level automatic matching library, carrying out conflict detection on the action list, an equipment maintenance work order and an energy scheduling plan, and dynamically adjusting according to a safety priority-production guarantee-energy saving optimization principle. The invention effectively improves the instantaneity, accuracy, coordination and automation level of the coal yard safety management.
assignees: NANJING RUISHI INTELLIGENT SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system with virtual participant for secure unmanned vehicle coordination
title_ko: 무인 이동체 협업 안정성을 위한 가상 참가자 생성 및 임무 할당 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A method for generating a virtual participant for unmanned vehicle collaboration stability and assigning a mission and a system thereof are disclosed. According to an exemplary embodiment, the method for generating a virtual participant for unmanned vehicle collaboration stability and assigning a mission and the system thereof include: a step of transmitting mission information to an unmanned vehicle under control; a step of generating a virtual participant for a virtual unmanned vehicle that is not under control; and a step of determining whether to generate an additional virtual participant for the virtual unmanned vehicle that is not under the control based on a mission plan transmitted from the unmanned vehicle under the control and the virtual unmanned vehicle which is not under the control. It is possible to estimate the attack/failure status of an enemy unmanned vehicle.
abstract_ko: 무인 이동체 협업 안정성을 위한 가상 참가자 생성 및 임무 할당 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다.  일 실시예에 따른 무인 이동체 협업 안정성을 위한 가상 참가자 생성 및 임무 할당 방법은 임무 정보를 관제 하에 있는 무인 이동체에 전송하는 단계와, 관제 하에 없는 가상 무인 이동체에 대해 가상 참가자를 생성하는 단계와, 상기 관제 하에 있는 무인 이동체와 상기 관제 하에 없는 가상 무인 이동체로부터 전송된 임무 계획에 기초하여 상기 관제 하에 없는 가상 무인 이동체에 대해 추가 가상 참가자 생성 여부를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: An integrated wireless command system on disaster site
title_ko: 재난 현장 무선 통합 지휘 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wireless integrated command system on a disaster site and, more particularly, to a system which is configured in a command control center for efficiently commanding and controlling rescue activities of disaster rescue workers which are deployed in a disaster site. The wireless integrated command system on a disaster site according to the embodiment of the present invention includes: a disaster information collecting and processing module, a multi-channel communication support module, a location tracking module which provides real-time location information of disaster rescue workers, an decision making support module, a communications module which supports wireless communications of an integrated control processor, and a database which stores various types of disaster information provided through the integrated control processor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 현장 무선 통합 지휘 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 재난 현장 전반을 지휘 통제하는 지휘통제본부에 구비되어 재난 현장에 투입되는 재난 구조요원들의 구조활동을 효과적으로 지휘 통제할 수 있도록 구성된 시스템으로서, 재난 현장 및 재난 구조대원의 상태 정보를 수집,처리하는 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈과, 재난 현장에서 통신 채널을 공유하여 다자간 통화가 가능하도록 하는 다채널 통신 지원 모듈과, 재난 구조요원의 실시간 위치 정보를 제공하는 위치 추적 모듈 및 재난 현장 통제에 대한 의사결정을 지원해주는 의사결정 지원모듈로 구성되는 통합 관제 프로세서를 구비하여, 상기 통합 관제 프로세서를 통해 재난 현장에서의 다자간 통화를 지원할 수 있고, 재난 현장의 상태와 재난 현장에 투입된 재난 구조대원의 상태 및 위치를 실시간으로 모니터링 할 수 있도록 하는 동시에, 재난 현장의 환경 상태나 재난 구조요원의 상태가 안전 기준범위를 초과하는 경우 경보를 발생시켜 재난 현장 통제에 대한 의사결정을 지원해줌으로써, 재난 현장 전반의 상황을 신속히 파악하여 재난 구조요원의 개인안전을 최대한 보호하고 재난 상황에 대해 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 하는 재난 현장 무선 통합 지휘 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은, 지휘통제본부에 구비되어 재난 현장 상황을 관제하기 위한 재난 현장 무선 통합 지휘 시스템에 있어서, 재난 현장에 투입되는 재난 구조요원이 구비한 센싱 장비로부터 전송되는 재난 현장의 상태 정보와 재난 구조요원의 상태 정보를 수집하여 모니터링할 수 있도록 처리하는 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈과; 상기 지휘통제본부와 재난 현장에 투입되는 재난 구조요원 및 유관기관의 현장 통제요원 간의 다자간 동시 통화가 가능하도록, 재난 현장에서 사용되는 서로 다른 통신채널의 통화 정보를 전송받아 채널 공유가 가능한 통신채널로 재전송하여 통신채널을 공유하도록 하는 다채널 통신 지원 모듈과; 재난 현장에 투입되는 재난 구조요원의 위치를 추적하여 실시간 위치 정보를 제공하는 위치 추적 모듈과; 상기 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈을 통해 제공되는 재난 현장의 및 재난 구조요원의 상태 정보와 상기 위치 추적 모듈을 통해 제공되는 재난 구조요원의 위치 정보를 기반으로, 재난 현장 통제에 대한 의사결정을 지원해주는 의사결정 지원모듈과; 상기 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈, 다채널 통신 지원 모듈 및 위치 추적 모듈의 무선 통신을 지원하는 통신 모듈; 및 상기 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈, 다채널 통신 지원 모듈, 위치 추적 모듈 및 의사결정 지원모듈을 통해 얻어지는 각종 재난 정보를 날짜 및 시간별로 저장하여 사건 내역을 기록하는 데이터베이스;를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue simulation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a maritime search and rescue simulation system, which mainly comprises a coach station, a main ship, a plurality of auxiliary ships, a search and rescue helicopter unit and a video frequency monitoring system, wherein the coach station is a command and control center of a development platform of the maritime search and rescue simulation system, and mainly completes the responsibility of a search and rescue protective dispatching center and an alarming platform, and plays the functions of managing and controlling the operation of the whole maritime search and rescue simulation development platform, the main ship simulates the functions of ships in distress or search and rescue ships, and carries out search and rescue actions under the command and the coordination of the coach station, the auxiliary ships are set as the ships in distress or the search and rescue ships according to the needs of searching exercises, and is allocated with a viewing field corner column curtain solid projecting visual scene system with an angle of 180 degrees, the search and rescue helicopter unit simulates a maritime search and rescue helicopter, under the command and the coordination of the coach station, carries out the search and rescue actions matching with the main and the auxiliary ships, the video frequency monitoring system mainly realizes the visual transmission function of video frequency information on search and rescue incident discovering fields. The simulation system has the beneficial effects that the system provides a platform supporting for researching the maritime search and rescue simulation system.

title_en: Multi-target cooperative scheduling method for lamp installation system and maintenance resource
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target cooperative scheduling method for a lamp installation system and maintenance resources, and relates to the technical field of industrial manufacturing. The multi-objective collaborative scheduling method based on the three-dimensional evaluation matrix, the abnormal level, the equipment value and the maintenance worker skill is innovatively provided, so that maintenance tasks are automatically distributed to nearest skill matching personnel, and work orders are pushed in real time through micro-letters. The system integrates the AGV and the maintenance robot to cooperatively operate, wherein the AGV automatically distributes spare parts according to a maintenance scheme, and the maintenance robot receives disassembly and assembly guidance by means of AR (augmented reality) glasses, so that the maintenance efficiency of complex equipment is improved. Meanwhile, a cross-factory resource borrowing mechanism is established, when the local spare parts are insufficient, the adjacent factory stock is automatically searched, and an allocation instruction is generated, so that the efficient sharing and coordination of the multi-factory maintenance resources are realized. The method remarkably improves abnormal response speed, equipment utilization rate and maintenance resource scheduling intellectualization level, and is suitable for large-scale distributed manufacturing scenes.
assignees: NINGBO HOMELINK ECO ITECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-park-oriented equipment operation and maintenance work order dispatching method and path planning system
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-park-oriented equipment operation and maintenance work order dispatching method and a path planning system, and belongs to the technical field of multi-park management. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of six-level topology of 'park-building-space-equipment-accessory-operation and maintenance personnel', splitting an operation and maintenance work order into feature vectors of skill requirements, accessory requirements and energy consumption sensitivity, generating an initial dispatching scheme and path planning based on the topological relation and the feature vectors, and dynamically adjusting the dispatching scheme and the path planning according to real-time feedback of an equipment monitoring system in the execution process. The application realizes the integrated intelligent decision and dynamic optimization of accessories, personnel, paths and energy consumption, effectively solves the problems of difficult resource coordination and response delay in multi-park operation and maintenance, and remarkably improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and the resource utilization rate.
assignees: WUHAN QICHUANG POWER DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Interactive wireless life safety communications system
abstract_en: An interactive wireless life safety communications system is disclosed. A central coordination server is linked to a first network, over which there is a connection to at least one resident life safety device at a specific location or for specific resident. An alarm signal is generated by the resident life safety device upon detection of an alarm condition and transmitted to the central coordination server. A caregiver communications device is connected to the central coordination server over a second network, and is receptive to an alarm notification that is generated by the central coordination server in response to the alarm signal. The caregiver communications device is also receptive to a caregiver user input, from which an action status response is generated for transmission to the central coordination server.

title_en: Nuclear energy operation and maintenance optimization method based on map driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance, in particular to a nuclear energy operation and maintenance optimization method based on map driving, which comprises the following steps: and acquiring equipment data and maintenance records, matching the marking states, screening a maintenance strategy, extracting a fault path by combining semantic reasoning, classifying deviation to generate an adaptability label, screening undisturbed tasks, extracting work order mapping distribution, judging and executing unbalance, calculating the periodic difference of the resource and task ratio record, and generating an operation and maintenance progress monitoring structural index. According to the invention, the accurate evaluation of the health state is realized through the mapping relation between the operation data and the maintenance record construction equipment and the working condition, the fault path and the deviation degree are identified by combining semantic reasoning, the adaptability of the maintenance strategy and the working condition is improved, the task interference risk is avoided, the load fluctuation is identified by means of the work order execution data, the resource input benefit evaluation mechanism is constructed by combining the resource and the task quantity comparison, and the fault prediction accuracy, the task execution coordination and the resource configuration rationality are improved.

title_en: A kind of co-development system and method towards intelligence manufacture
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of co-development system and method towards intelligence manufacture, the system include：Requirement analysis module：To obtain demand of the client to product before the production of product, and demand is explained according to knowledge, is classified, and is converted into task；Task-decomposing module：Demand according to client to product generates general assignment, then carries out task subdivision to general assignment and function is segmented, be finally decomposed to form identifiable multiple subtasks；Assign task module：To description task and problem be allocated, and task execution process decision element and the optimization algorithm of process model are selected, by each task assignment to relevant collaborative design module；Co-development module：To receive and execute the task of appointment, and implementing result is assessed and analyzed.Compared with prior art, the present invention has many advantages, such as coordination, intuitive efficient, dynamic change, production flexibility.

title_en: Intelligent object management full-state system management application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent object management state management system and method, and belongs to the technical field of property management informatization. The system comprises a central server and a user terminal communicated with the central server, and integrates a plurality of business modules such as comprehensive project management, financial charging, warehouse management, personnel attendance, special vehicle management, municipal sanitation management and the like. The core of the invention is that through the cooperative operation of the modules, the data island of each department in the traditional property management is broken, and the automation of the cross-department business process is realized. For example, the work order generated by the system can automatically call personnel, materials and vehicle resources to complete the whole-flow closed-loop management from task issuing to cost accounting. Meanwhile, the system is used for interfacing external requirements through the owner service applet and automatically generating various operation reports. The invention effectively solves the problems of low management efficiency and rough management of the traditional property, and realizes the intelligent and refined management of property states and the efficient coordination of resources.
assignees: QINGDAO DEXIN ZHENSHAN SMART URBAN OPERATION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle intelligence real-time command management system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent real-time command management system for an unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent real-time command management system comprises a communication control station, a command and dispatch center and an unmanned aerial vehicle system, wherein the electrical output end of the unmanned aerial vehicle system is electrically connected with the electrical input end of the communication control station and the electrical input end of the command and dispatch center, and the unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft subsystem, a task and equipment subsystem, a measurement and control and information transmission subsystem, a command and control subsystem, an emission and recovery subsystem and a guarantee and maintenance subsystem. The intelligent real-time command management system for the unmanned aerial vehicle, provided by the invention, can transmit various information to the patrollers and the commanders in real time, is more convenient for the patrollers to command and acquire the security information of each forest area, and greatly improves the safety and the efficiency of the patrollers.

title_en: Hospital disaster computer system
title_ko: 병원 재난 전산 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 병원 내외 재난, 사고 등이 초래될 경우를 대비한 훈련과 실제 재난, 사고 등의 발생에 있어 의료서비스의 중지 및 혼선이 없이 상시적으로 병원 내외 재난훈련을 가능토록 하여 병원 관계자들에게 명확한 역할 부여 및 이에 따른 상황 대응, 지휘체계, 협업, 평가 및 미비점 보완 등이 이루어짐에 따라 실제 재난, 사고 발생시 즉각적인 대응 및 의료서비스의 지속성을 유지하는 병원 재난 전산 시스템에 관한 것으로, 교육자로 하여금 재난상황 설정 및 피교육자로 하여금 설정된 재난상황에 대한 대응을 입력 가능하게 하여 실시간 재난상황 훈련과 소통을 가능하게 하는 입력부(100); 입력부(100)에 입력된 교육자의 재난상황 설정 데이터 및 피교육자의 대응 데이터를 저장 및 관리하여 성과 평가와 개선을 가능하게 하는 서버부(200); 서버부(200)에 저장된 데이터를 적어도 한 구역 이상 분할된 화면으로 출력하여 교육자 및 피교육자로 하여금 가시적으로 재난상황 및 재난상황에 대한 대응내역을 확인 가능하게 하는 출력부(300);로 구성되며, 상기 입력부(100);는, 재난상황 설정과 피교육자에 대한 임무를 할당 가능한 교육자입력부(110); 교육자입력부(110)에 의해 설정된 재난상황에 대한 대응을 입력 가능한 피교육자입력부(120);로 구성되어 교육자가 설정한 재난상황에 대하여 피교육자의 대응능력 및 피교육자들간 소통 협업을 이루어지도록 하고, 상기 교육자입력부(110);는, 재난상황의 명칭, 장소, 시간, 목표, 교육자 정보가 포함된 기본정보를 입력 가능하게 하는 기본정보입력부(111); 재난상황 교육내용, 시간, 진행 교육자 정보가 포함된 교육프로그램 정보를 입력 가능하게 하는 교육프로그램입력부(112); 재난상황 발생 및 각 재난상황에 대한 안내 메시지를 순차적으로 발송하고 발송되는 메시지의 저장 및 수정, 발송 순서를 입력 가능하게 하는 메시지입력부(113); 재난상황 교육이 실시되는 병원 정보를 입력 가능하게 하는 병원정보입력부(114); 재난상황의 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책을 포함하는 피교육자정보를 입력 가능토록 하고 입력된 피교육자정보를 수정 입력이 가능한 피교육자정보입력부(115); 재난상황에 대한 요약정보를 입력 가능하게 하여 피교육자로 하여금 재난상황을 문자로 확인할 수 있도록 하는 재난정보입력부(116); 재난상황 하에 피교육자의 활동 팀과 임무를 입력 가능하게 하는 팀및임무할당부(117); 재난상황 하에 활용 가능한 물품의 종류와 수량을 입력 가능하게 하는 물품입력부(118); 피교육자들의 재난상황 대응 결과 및 시기를 설정, 삭제 가능하게 구성하는 사고조치입력부(119);를 포함하며, 상기 피교육자입력부(120);는, 재난상황의 대응 내용을 작성 및 전송 가능하게 하는 피교육자메시지입력부(121); 피교육자에게 할당된 임무와 설정된 팀의 변경, 자구 수정 입력을 가능하게 하는 정보변경부(122);를 포함하고, 상기 피교육자메시지입력부(121);는, 재난상황 발생시 메시지 전송으로 피교육자간 소통을 위한 문구를 설정 및 추가 입력을 가능하게 하는 입력설정부(121a);를 더 포함하고, 상기 출력부(300);는, 입력부(100)에 교육자가 입력하는 정보를 토대로 적어도 한 구역 이상 구분된 화면으로 출력하여 교육자의 재난상황 설정과 피교육자의 대응내역을 확인 가능하게 하는 교육자출력부(310); 입력부(100)에 피교육자가 입력하는 정보를 토대로 적어도 한 구역 이상 구분된 화면으로 출력하여 피교육자간 대응과 임무의 완수하도록 하는 피교육자출력부(320);로 구성되어 피교육자간 협업과 재난상황 훈련이후 피교육자의 훈련성과 평가 및 개선점을 파악할 수 있도록 하며, 한편, 상기 교육자입력부(110) 상에는 피교육자입력부(120)와 달리 피교육자입력부(120)에 비해 추가로 재난상황에 능숙한 전문가를 구별할 수 있는 사용자 인증이 추가로 이루어지고, 또한, 상기 교육자입력부(110)의 각 기본정보입력부(111); 교육프로그램입력부(112); 메시지입력부(113); 병원정보입력부(114); 피교육자정보입력부(115); 재난정보입력부(116); 팀및임무할당부(117); 물품입력부(118); 사고조치입력부(119);에는 데이터를 입력하기 위해 각각 분할된 화면이 제공되고, 공란에 데이터를 입력하는 방법으로 각각의 기본정보, 교육프로로그램 정보, 피교육자정보, 병원정보가 입력됨과 아울러 출력부(300) 상에도 입력이 필요한 정보를 공란으로 설정하고 이에 대한 데이터 입력이 가능한 화면을 제공하며, 그리고, 피교육자정보입력부(115) 상에는 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책을 작성 가능한 문서를 제공하는 문서제공부(115a); 기본정보입력부(111)의 기본정보에 포함된 교육자 정보를 토대로 교육자목록을 출력하는 교육자목록출력부(312); 메시지입력부(113)에 저장된 메시지를 출력하는 교육메시지출력부(313); 피교육자정보입력부(115) 및 팀및임무할당부(117)에 입력된 피교육자별 팀과 임무를 구분하여 표 형식으로 출력하는 피교육자및부서출력부(314); 피교육자의 접속 여부를 확인 가능하게 출력하는 접속출력부(315); 피교육자별 대응내역을 확인 가능하게 구성하고 대응내역을 일지로 구성하여 출력하는 일지출력부(316); 사고조치입력부(119)의 재난상황 대응 결과 및 시기를 설정, 삭제 가능하도록 출력하는 사고조치출력부(317);를 더 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Systematic outage planning and coordination in a distribution grid
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system and method for automated outage and workflow planning system in a distributed electrical power grid with planned de-energization of electrical equipment as opposed to responding to an unplanned power outage. An automated system provides core conflict resolution and power outage planning. The present invention automatically notifies requestors of upcoming work orders. In addition, the present invention reduces scheduling inefficiencies by requiring requestors to confirm, decline, or edit on the fly their pending work order(s). The system also determines if all the orders are not completed and places the order back on the calendar for another day.

title_en: Personnel deployment method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a personnel deployment method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the predicted quantity of a first type of worksheets of a first grid in a first time period; the first grid is any one of a plurality of grids obtained by dividing a target area, a first objective function is constructed based on the work order prediction quantity, a first objective parameter value when the first objective function takes the minimum function value is determined, the function value of the first objective function indicates the cost of a first deployment scheme, the first objective deployment scheme indicated by the first objective parameter value comprises the target quantity of ground staff with first skills distributed to the first grid, and the ground staff is deployed according to the first deployment scheme. By applying the ground staff deployment method in the embodiment of the application, the demand prediction can be performed in advance, the skill matching degree can be improved, the space-time coordination can be performed efficiently, and the dynamic adjustment capability can be improved.

title_en: Online Work Management System with Job Division Support
abstract_en: An online work management system provides a marketplace for multiple job owner and workers. The job owners provide a job description that defines task. The job description may be processed to generate task descriptions that may be published for workers' application. The task descriptions specify the qualification or restrictions for workers to have the task assigned. The online work management system also provides various functions supporting coordination and management of task assignment such as determining the trust level of the user's identity, search the tasks or workers, monitoring the progress of job, managing payment to workers, training and testing the workers, evaluating the review by the job owners, and generation of surveys.

title_en: Multi-vehicle coordination-based vehicle scheduling system and method, electronic apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: A multi-vehicle coordination-based vehicle scheduling system and method, an electronic apparatus, and a storage medium. The scheduling system includes a parameter module configured for determining a scheduling parameter; a scheduling module configured for determining a scheduling result; a coordination module configured for determining a coordination impact value; a correction module configured for correcting the scheduling parameter, the correction module judging whether the coordination impact value is no less than a preset threshold, correcting the scheduling parameter based on a judgment result that the coordination impact value is no less than the preset threshold, and re-determining the scheduling result and the coordination impact value based on the corrected scheduling parameter; and an output module configured for outputting the scheduling result based on the judgment result that the coordination impact value is less than the preset threshold. Sequence order and task assignment problems when scheduling multiple vehicles are effectively solved.

title_en: Multi-source data fusion-based intelligent power disaster decision and movement cooperative system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system management, and discloses a power disaster intelligent decision and movement cooperative system, equipment and a storage medium based on multi-source data fusion. The system comprises a rule management module, an intelligent decision module and a mobile coordination module, wherein the rule management module is used for configuring a multi-disaster dynamic rule base supporting icing, forest fire and flood prevention, associating sensor threshold values with treatment strategies, the intelligent decision module is used for accessing sensor data streams such as weather, icing thickness and water level in real time, generating a treatment work order through rule matching by a rule engine, and the mobile coordination module is used for pushing the work order to a terminal and integrating a geographic information visualization interface, receiving on-site treatment images and progress feedback and realizing work order state closed-loop tracking. The system adopts a distributed architecture to process high concurrency data, combines role authority control to ensure data security, solves the problems of lag response, fragmentation disposal and low cooperative efficiency of the traditional disasters, and realizes the whole-flow mobile cooperative management of disaster sensing, decision making, execution and verification.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: A kind of electronic work order of Machine Manufacture digitlization workshop information transmission
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electronic work order of Machine Manufacture digitlization workshop information transmission, belong to intelligence manufacture information interconnection and intercommunication field.Product information, technique information, facility information status information and workshop management information involved by the workshop of Machine Manufacture digitlization at present are difficult to realize effective system integrating between each isomery software and hardware and interconnected.Electronic work order of the present invention employs a kind of method for being described and being transmitted as the unified all information to involved by Machine Manufacture digitlization workshop of functional node and resource node, is corresponding linking relationship of the functional node with resource node by machine tool product data structure and production process organizational logical Automated generalization.The invention provides realizing that the data exchange that networking, digital coordination work unifies form between a kind of Machine Manufacture digitlization each functional module of either inside and with tension management system, solve different vendor's equipment isomery and platform variability issues.

title_en: Interactive wireless life safety communications system
abstract_en: An interactive wireless life safety communications system is disclosed. A central coordination server is linked to a first network, over which there is a connection to at least one resident life safety device at a specific location or for specific resident. An alarm signal is generated by the resident life safety device upon detection of an alarm condition and transmitted to the central coordination server. A caregiver communications device is connected to the central coordination server over a second network, and is receptive to an alarm notification that is generated by the central coordination server in response to the alarm signal. The caregiver communications device is also receptive to a caregiver user input, from which an action status response is generated for transmission to the central coordination server.

title_en: Coal yard safety equipment management method and system based on environment monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal yard safety management and environment monitoring, and discloses a coal yard safety equipment management method and system based on environment monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting environment data and equipment running state data in real time; generating an environment-running state-equipment association data set, eliminating interference data caused by production stoppage maintenance and operation planning, carrying out abnormal marking on data exceeding a preset safety threshold at any point in the association data set, carrying out risk index calculation on the abnormally marked data to obtain a risk index, generating a safety equipment action list based on a risk level automatic matching library, carrying out conflict detection on the action list, an equipment maintenance work order and an energy scheduling plan, and dynamically adjusting according to a safety priority-production guarantee-energy saving optimization principle. The invention effectively improves the instantaneity, accuracy, coordination and automation level of the coal yard safety management.

title_en: Road and government work order generation method and system for intelligent coordination of vehicle and road
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a road and government work order generation method and system for intelligent cooperation of a vehicle and a road. The method comprises the steps of cooperatively collecting vehicle road state data of a target road through a vehicle-mounted terminal and a road side unit, verifying road damage based on the vehicle road state data to generate a disease verification result, performing maintenance authentication according to the verification result, collecting traffic flow and dynamically calculating maintenance priority, returning the target road, the verification result and the priority to a system, filling in a work order template according to fields to generate a first road political work order, connecting a service distribution system, and executing distribution and storage management of the work order. The application solves the technical problems of low work order generation efficiency and poor accuracy caused by manual input and insufficient data verification in the traditional road government work order generation, and realizes the technical effects of collecting vehicle road state data through a vehicle terminal and a road side unit, automatically verifying road diseases and improving the automation degree and the accuracy of the road government work order generation.

title_en: Data management and control and application system for distributed education big data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of work order task coordination, and particularly relates to a data management and control and application system of large data of distributed education, which comprises the following steps: s1: receiving an interaction instruction sent by a client; s2: acquiring an interaction instruction, extracting an interaction appointed keyword, arranging an upstream responsible person under a corresponding department according to the keyword, and marking the upstream responsible person as an initial upstream responsible person; s3, constructing a chat dialogue box between the client and the initial upstream responsible person, and processing the client problem by the initial upstream responsible person; the method for collaborative processing of worksheets in multitasking mode can enter upstream responsible persons of multiple departments simultaneously through constructing the multi-person chat dialog box to take charge of handling customer problems, meanwhile, the initial upstream responsible person judges and pulls upstream responsible persons of other departments, collaborative efficiency is improved, the initial upstream responsible person introduces the problems to the secondary upstream responsible person, omission is avoided, and customer experience is improved.

title_en: Service endowment platform
abstract_en: The present invention relates to one kind to service endowment platform, including registration module, data management module and service for life module；The registration module typing user information, user information include personal information, family members' information, health and fitness information and hobby information, are transmitted to data management module；The data management module stores user information, while user information is transmitted to service for life module；The service for life module generates demand information according to user information, selects service provider, generates work order, and notice service businessman is serviced in the form of short message.Compared with the prior art, registration module of the invention, data management module and the running of service for life module coordination, can realize and carry out automation services management to user, lift convenience.

title_en: Hazardous and noxious substance environment sensitivity index map providing device
title_ko: 위험유해물질 방제정보지도 제공 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hazardous and noxious substance (HNS) environment sensitivity index map providing device, which integrates a coastline type, a fractal dimension, and wave information, derives an environment sensitivity index of the coastline, and sets a first control target region when an HNS is spilled, thereby enabling a user to efficiently control a HNS pollution ocean accident, and comprises: an environment sensitivity index map providing unit for providing an environment sensitivity index map providing interface to an accessed user so as to perform an interaction, and providing an environment sensitivity index map; and a storage unit for storing a database, which stores and provides, to the environment sensitivity index map providing unit, commanding system and contact system information, environment information, map and satellite image information, control guideline information, coastline information, sensitive resource information, control resource information, and commodity supply information, wherein all of the information is for producing the environment sensitivity index map.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해안선의 유형, 프랙탈 차원 및 파랑 정보를 통합하여 해안선의 환경민감도 지수를 도출하여 위험유해물질(HNS: Hazard and Noxious Substance)의 유출 시 우선 방제 대상 지역을 설정하여 해양 HNS 오염 사고에 대한 효율적인 방제를 수행할 수 있도록 하는 위험유해물질 방제정보지도 제공 장치로서, 접속된 사용자에게 방제정보지도제공 인터페이스를 제공하여 상호작용을 수행하며 방제정보지도를 제공하는 방제정보지도제공부; 및 방제정보지도 제작을 위한 지휘체계 및 연락처체계 정보와, 환경정보와, 지도 및 위성 영상 정보와, 방제지침정보와, 해안선정보와, 민감자원정보와, 방제자원정보와, 물자보급정보를 저장하여 방제정보지도제공부로 제공하는 데이터베이스를 저장하는 저장부;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Method and system for providing activity-centric awareness in a virtual collaboration space with personalized differential awareness user interface representations
abstract_en: A system for providing an activity-centric collaboration space provides representations of the tasks that the team has planned, is engaged in, and has completed as a means of enhancing cross-team awareness and coordination. The system enables a user to explicitly indicate what task she is currently engaged in on behalf of the team, and makes this current task information available to other team members. A “tasks” view user interface component provides a shared view of all ongoing, planned, and completed tasks for a team. Information about team members' task assignments, and the ability to monitor team members' current tasks, may be used to manage potential interruptions caused by requests for instant messaging sessions and the like. Team members can explicitly establish interruption management policies indicating how task assignments and current tasks should be used to determine whether a communication attempt should be blocked or forwarded to a team member. Team space resources that are most important to an individual team member may also be identified, and changes made to those resources made more visually apparent and/or readily available to that user than changes to artifacts with which they are less concerned. Personalized differential awareness user interface representations may also be provided, and the associations that tasks establish between resources and team members also enables convenient determination of whether newly added or modified resources would be of interest to a particular user.

title_en: System and method for remote collaboration based on realistic content between field boundaries and command control in edge cloud
title_ko: 엣지 클라우드에서 현장 경계와 지휘 통제 간 실감 콘텐츠 기반의 원격 협업 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A remote collaboration system according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a client terminal for generating observation data by sensing an observation target; an edge terminal for extracting scalar information on the basis of observation data received from the client terminal, determining a normal or abnormal state of the observation target on the basis of the scalar information, and transmitting the observation data to a central server when a state is in an abnormal state; the central server that transmits situation information obtained by determining a situation of the observation target on the basis of the observation data received from the edge terminal to a control server; and the control server that performs a predetermined protocol according to the situation information. The system is used for robots, drones, and self-driving cars that require real-time data processing and interworking, and can be used for a new artificial intelligence ICT infrastructure interlocked with 6G technology in the future.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 원격 협업 시스템은 관측 대상을 센싱하여 관측 데이터를 생성하는 클라이언트 단말; 상기 클라이언트 단말로부터 수신한 관측 데이터를 기초로 스칼라 정보를 추출하여 상기 스칼라 정보를 기초로 상기 관측 대상의 정상 또는 이상 상태를 판별하여 이상 상태인 경우에 상기 관측 데이터를 중앙 서버로 전송하는 엣지 단말; 상기 엣지 단말로부터 수신한 상기 관측 데이터를 기초로 상기 관측 대상의 상황을 판별한 상황 정보를 관제 서버에 전송하는 중앙 서버; 및 상기 상황 정보에 따라 기 정해진 프로토콜을 수행하는 관제 서버를 포함하여 실시간 데이터 처리와 상호 연동이 필요한 로봇, 드론, 자율주행자동차 등에 활용되어, 향후 6G 기술과 맞물려지는 새로운 인공지능 ICT 인프라에 활용이 가능하다.

title_en: Work order full-flow intelligent circulation system with base surface facing hotline
abstract_en: The invention provides a work order full-flow intelligent circulation system with base-oriented hotline, belonging to the crossing field of artificial intelligence and digital government technology, the invention disassembles the whole work order flow of the hotline into subtasks completed by six special agents of work order acceptance and semantic understanding, classification and routing, dispatch and scheduling, treatment execution, result checking and feedback, citizen evaluation and data analysis. The agents communicate and cooperate based on the MCP protocol, and the MCP server is used for uniformly calling tools, inquiring a knowledge base and managing contexts, so that precise understanding, efficient dispatching, closed-loop treatment and intelligent analysis of citizen appeal are realized. The system effectively solves the problems of dependence on manpower, low efficiency, unsmooth circulation, difficult tracing and the like in the traditional heat-line work order processing, and realizes the automation, the intellectualization and the coordination of the whole work order processing flow.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent dispatching method and system for container terminal trucks based on multiple driving modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dispatching method and system for container terminal trucks based on a multi-driving mode, comprising the steps of constructing a full-flow system architecture integrating a central dispatching platform, a vehicle-mounted intelligent terminal and a sensing and communication network, collecting basic data of vehicles, tasks, road networks and environments, constructing a multi-objective optimization function, establishing a dangerous goods risk integration model, respectively setting mathematical constraints for task assignment, path planning, hybrid driving coordination, dynamic path tracking and mode switching to form a multi-dimensional mathematical model, adopting an improved non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm solution model to generate a personalized dispatching scheme comprising vehicle-task assignment, path planning, time requirements and risk control rules, respectively adopting MPC dynamic path tracking for unmanned vehicles, providing visual and voice state guiding for manual driving vehicles through the cooperation of the central dispatching platform and the vehicle-mounted intelligent terminal, and implementing hybrid driving coordination control to ensure the operation efficiency of the vehicles and the transportation safety of dangerous goods.

title_en: Enterprise personnel management system
abstract_en: The invention provides an enterprise personnel management system, relating to a computer management system. The system is divided into seven modules which are a department management module, a recruitment management module, an employee management module, a training management module, a reward and punishment management module, a payroll management module, and a system management module. The department management module comprises an adding department unit, a viewing department unit and a deleting department unit. The system of the invention has comprehensive functions and is simple to operate, the basic information of the enterprise staff can be stored, the working task of the enterprise staff can be allocated and managed, the information and working states of the staff can be rapidly grasped, the potential of the enterprise staff can be fulfilled, and the relation between enterprise operators and the staff is treated harmoniously. The manpower and cost of enterprise human resource management are reduced, and the efficiency of the human resources management is improved. Planning, organization, coordination, command and control are carried out for the various corresponding governance activities, thus the enterprise reform is promoted, the enterprise organization efficiency is improved, and the core competitiveness of the enterprise is enhanced.

title_en: Equipment cloud monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an equipment cloud monitoring system which comprises a cloud platform, an equipment data acquisition module, an equipment asset management module, an equipment asset multi-dimensional display module, a maintenance management module, a work order management module, a maintenance planning module, a spare part management module, an equipment internet of things access module, a mobile coordination module, an equipment management signboard, a yield statistics signboard, a real-time query module, a reminding module and an alarm module, wherein the equipment data acquisition module is used for acquiring the data of equipment assets; the invention has the beneficial effects that: aiming at the current situation that timely process data cannot be acquired manually, the cloud monitoring system provides an equipment production data real-time acquisition function based on the intelligent gateway, and a user can effectively reduce the acquisition cost of related personnel through real-time query; by utilizing a signal representation and identification technology, the running condition of the equipment and the damage position and severity of the fault are diagnosed in real time, and when the equipment has an overrun fault, maintenance personnel are reminded to take measures in time; the equipment is detected when the overrun fault occurs, so that the detection accuracy of the overrun fault of the equipment is improved, and the false alarm is avoided.
