title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle control right handover method based on air-ground cooperation
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle control right handover method based on air-ground coordination, wherein the takeoff and recovery of an unmanned aerial vehicle are controlled by a ground station, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is handed over by a helicopter and the ground station when preparing to execute an aerial task and after finishing the task, namely the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled by the helicopter in a task stage, so that the reconnaissance area of the unmanned aerial vehicle is not limited any more, a helicopter commander can directly acquire the state of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the response and processing efficiency of emergency situations is improved. The task execution area of the unmanned aerial vehicle is not limited by a ground station any more, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can execute tasks by flying to a farther area along with a helicopter; the helicopter commander can know the state of the unmanned aerial vehicle in time, thereby avoiding the danger of the unmanned aerial vehicle approaching the helicopter and improving the flight safety; the helicopter instructs the unmanned aerial vehicle in the air, shortens the loop of the whole information decision, and reduces the action lag caused by mutual waiting in the mixed formation of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the human.
assignees: XIAN AISHENG TECH GROUP CO LTD;UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Intelligent tower crane cooperative control system and method based on task tree model
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent tower crane cooperative control system and method based on a task tree model. The method allows the engineering operation to be issued in the mode of descriptive information such as natural language and work order tables, converts the descriptive information of the engineering operation into a temporal correlation sequence consisting of a series of operation tasks, combines the equipment state parameter information of the intelligent tower crane and the real-time perception information of a working scene, executes matching of the operation tasks, the equipment state and the working scene of the intelligent tower crane, and performs task tree decision and cooperative scheduling on the basis of the temporal correlation sequence, so that an instant operation instruction is issued to each intelligent tower crane in the intelligent tower crane cluster in an autonomous decision mode, conflicts in the aspects of space and material are avoided, and the coordination control and adjustment capacity of the intelligent tower crane cluster is enhanced.
assignees: HANGZHOU DAJIE INTELLIGENT TRANS TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear energy operation and maintenance optimization method based on map driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance, in particular to a nuclear energy operation and maintenance optimization method based on map driving, which comprises the following steps: and acquiring equipment data and maintenance records, matching the marking states, screening a maintenance strategy, extracting a fault path by combining semantic reasoning, classifying deviation to generate an adaptability label, screening undisturbed tasks, extracting work order mapping distribution, judging and executing unbalance, calculating the periodic difference of the resource and task ratio record, and generating an operation and maintenance progress monitoring structural index. According to the invention, the accurate evaluation of the health state is realized through the mapping relation between the operation data and the maintenance record construction equipment and the working condition, the fault path and the deviation degree are identified by combining semantic reasoning, the adaptability of the maintenance strategy and the working condition is improved, the task interference risk is avoided, the load fluctuation is identified by means of the work order execution data, the resource input benefit evaluation mechanism is constructed by combining the resource and the task quantity comparison, and the fault prediction accuracy, the task execution coordination and the resource configuration rationality are improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU YUANHE SHUZHI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for cooperatively constructing progress of nuclear power equipment in engineering stage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for cooperatively constructing progress of nuclear power equipment in an engineering stage, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating endowed attributes of the equipment according to the equipment design; acquiring the planned arrival time of the equipment according to the purchase scheme; a room handover plan and a system installation completion report handover plan formulated according to the endowed attribute of the equipment and the construction scheme; obtaining a planned installation time of the device according to the endowed attribute of the device, the room handover plan and the system installation completion report handover plan; calculating a difference value according to the planned installation time and the planned arrival time; and judging whether the actual safety requirements are met according to the difference value, if the actual safety requirements are not met, calculating the variable function value according to the attribute given to the equipment, and pre-judging the risk and sending out an early warning signal. The invention realizes the coordination of upstream and downstream progress by taking equipment as an object, and achieves the requirements and targets of accurate goods supply, smooth construction and stock decompression.

title_en: Vehicle installed mobile device and server for gps services and task assignments
abstract_en: Mobile device installed in a vehicle for communicating a current location and a current destination, to a coordination server, receiving a set of tasks (statically assigned or dynamically assigned) for the user (for example, from the server or from another user or adhoc tasks specified by a customer), displaying the set of tasks to the user, receiving a completion response (successful or unsuccessful) from the user, and proceeding to the next waypoint along a route/trip plan. A coordination server facilitates communication of a list of tasks dynamically and opportunistically assigned to a user to be performed at a specified location.

title_en: Multi-park-oriented equipment operation and maintenance work order dispatching method and path planning system
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-park-oriented equipment operation and maintenance work order dispatching method and a path planning system, and belongs to the technical field of multi-park management. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of six-level topology of 'park-building-space-equipment-accessory-operation and maintenance personnel', splitting an operation and maintenance work order into feature vectors of skill requirements, accessory requirements and energy consumption sensitivity, generating an initial dispatching scheme and path planning based on the topological relation and the feature vectors, and dynamically adjusting the dispatching scheme and the path planning according to real-time feedback of an equipment monitoring system in the execution process. The application realizes the integrated intelligent decision and dynamic optimization of accessories, personnel, paths and energy consumption, effectively solves the problems of difficult resource coordination and response delay in multi-park operation and maintenance, and remarkably improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and the resource utilization rate.

title_en: Multi-vehicle coordination-based vehicle scheduling system, method, electronic apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: A multi-vehicle coordination-based vehicle scheduling system, a method, an electronic apparatus, and a storage medium. The scheduling system comprises: a parameter module (310) used to determine a scheduling parameter; a scheduling module (320) used to determine a scheduling result; a coordination module (330) used to determine a coordination impact value; a correction module (340) used to correct the scheduling parameter, wherein the correction module determines whether the coordination impact value is not less than a preset threshold, and if so, corrects the scheduling parameter, and re-determines, on the basis of the corrected scheduling parameter, the scheduling result and the coordination impact value; and an output module (350) used to output the scheduling result when the result of the determination is that the coordination impact value is less than the preset threshold. The invention effectively solves sequence order and task assignment problems when scheduling multiple vehicles, and resolves issues that arise when operating multiple vehicles, such as multi-vehicle conflicts, congestion, impractical arrangements, and the like, thereby improving efficiency in completing transportation tasks.

title_en: Apparatus for 5G IoT device employing accident management vehicle
title_ko: 사고관리차량 탑재용 5G 기반의 IoT 디바이스 장치
abstract_en: An embodiment relates to a 5G-based IoT device for mounting an accident management vehicle. Specifically, the IoT device comprises a 5G device-based video system technology for two-way responds between a control center and a command vehicle to allow the control (command) center to identify and respond to a situation in real time in case of a disaster or catastrophic accident on a bridge or large bridge. Additionally, the IoT device comprises a deep learning-based video magnification technology for centralized control and an IP speaker control technology for establishing a response system for each section. Therefore, the embodiment provides a support technology that can prevent secondary collisions and minimize damage through recognition of a traffic accident and rapid judgment and response according to a type of the accident. In addition, in case of a collision accident, video support is available such that the control center can check the collision accident and cooperate with related organizations (fire department, police station, etc.). Additionally, accurate transfer of a situation and response to the collision are possible through the 5G new technology-based video sharing for an existing accident handling communication system between an accident management vehicle and the control center, such as walkie-talkies and wired/wireless phones. Furthermore, IP speakers are installed for each road facility section and support selective evacuation/announcement such as detour guidance by distance centering on an accident point, forward accident guidance, and warning announcement, to provide convenience and smooth measures.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 사고관리차량 탑재용 5G 기반형 IoT 디바이스 장치에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로, 이러한 IoT 디바이스 장치는 교량 및 대교에서 재난, 재해 사고가 났을 경우, 상황을 관제(지휘) 센터에서 현장의 상황을 실시간으로 파악하고 대응할 수 있도록 5G 디바이스 기반형 관제 센터/ 지휘 차량 간 양방향 대응 영상체계 기술이다. 그리고, 이러한 IoT 디바이스 장치는 이에 더하여, 집중 관제를 위한 딥러닝 기반 영상확대 기술과 구간별 대응체계 수립을 위한 IP스피커 제어기술을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
따라서, 이를 통해 실시예는 교통사고에 대한 인지, 사고형태에 따른 신속한 판단과 대응을 통해 2차 추돌사고를 방지 및 피해 최소화할 수 있는 지원 기술확보를 제공한다. 
그리고, 충돌사고 발생 시, 관제 센터에서 이를 확인하고 유관기관(소방청, 경찰청 등)과 연계 협력이 이루어 질 수 있도록 영상 지원이 가능하다. 
또한, 기존 사고관리 차량과 관제 센터 간의 무전기, 유무선전화기 등 사고수습 의사교환 체계를 5G 신기술 기반 영상공유를 통해 정확한 상황 전달 가능 및 충돌사고 대처가 가능하다. 
이에 더하여, 또한 IP스피커를 통하여 도로시설물 구간별로 설치하고 사고지점을 중심으로 거리별 우회도로 안내, 전방 사고 안내, 경보방송 안내 등 선별 대피/안내방송 지원을 통해 편의와 원활하 조치를 제공한다.

title_en: Emergency rescue apparatus equipped with safety tools
title_ko: 수분 감지형 구명환 및 구명볼을 겸비한 송수신 비상지휘체계 보관시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transmission and receiving emergency system (100) having moisture-detectable life ring and life ball integrated with a life ring (10); a life ball (20) engaged with the life ring by being inserted into the life ring; a waterproof accepting part (30) attached to the top of a space for the life ring (10) and the life ball (20); an emergency signal unit (35) on the waterproof accepting part (30); and a see-through part (40) fixed on the outer side of the life ring (10). [Reference numerals] (20) Rescue ball
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수분 감지형 구명환 및 구명볼을 겸비한 송수신 비상지휘체계 보관시스템(100)에 관한 것으로, 구명환(10)과; 상기 구명환(10)과 체결되어 그 내측 공간에 삽입되는 구명볼(20)과; 상기 구명환(10)과 상기 구명볼(20) 공간의 상측에 부착되는 방수수납부(30)와; 상기 방수수납부(30) 상에 설치되는 비상신호 발생수단(35)과; 상기 구명환(10)의 외측에 고정되는 외부투시부(40); 를 일체로 구비하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Item distribution method, item distribution system, computer device, and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a computer device and a medium for distributing items, which automatically identify execution departments for execution according to matching conditions of a processing work order and the execution departments contained in the processing items after matching corresponding processing items according to reported information, and when the processing work order is not bound with the execution departments, automatically match the execution departments by re-matching the corresponding execution departments according to identification characters after splitting the reported information into identification characters by using semantic identification, thereby preventing the corresponding execution departments from being incapable of being accurately matched due to unclear division of authority of the departments, solving the problems that in the prior art, the processing work orders contained in the processing items are more, and when the authority of the execution departments involved in the processing work order is not clear, the communication coordination efficiency among the execution departments is low easily, and improving the processing efficiency of the processing items.
assignees: BEIJING BEIMING SHUKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Gas pipeline-third party construction coupling hidden danger identification and management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas pipeline-third-party construction coupling hidden danger identification and management system, which comprises a third-party construction management module, a supervision coordination module, a hidden danger management module, a task management module and a data management module, wherein the third-party construction management module is used for acquiring and analyzing third-party construction information and finishing information interaction between a gas company and a third-party construction unit; the supervision coordination module is used for assigning work order personnel of the gas company to perform dispatching, routing inspection, special supervision and coordination tasks on the pipelines in the third-party construction range; the hidden danger management module is used for managing and analyzing hidden danger data in the third-party construction process; the task management module is used for managing and analyzing the third-party construction hidden danger processing data; the data management module is used for storing and processing system data; the invention has the advantages that: the intelligent interaction platform of the gas company and a third-party construction unit is provided, and the informatization level of third-party construction management and the identification and treatment strength of the third-party construction hidden danger are improved.
assignees: HEFEI ZEZHONG CITY INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH;HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Robot and control method thereof
title_ko: 로봇 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: A robot is disclosed. The robot comprises a sensor, a driving unit, a communication interface, and a processor. The processor may: obtain first context data through the sensor; receive second context data obtained by at least one other robot through the communication interface; identify at least one context data among the first context data and the second context data on the basis of a collaboration scenario of the robot and the at least one other robot; obtain task information corresponding to the robot by inputting the identified at least one context data to a preconfigured task assignment algorithm related to collaboration; and control the driving unit on the basis of the obtained task information.
abstract_ko: 로봇이 개시된다. 로봇은 센서, 구동부, 통신 인터페이스 및 프로세서를 포함한다. 프로세서는 센서를 통해 제1 컨텍스트(context) 데이터를 획득하고, 적어도 하나의 타 로봇에 의해 획득된 제2 컨텍스트 데이터를 통신 인터페이스를 통해 수신하고, 로봇 및 적어도 하나의 타 로봇의 협업 시나리오에 기초하여 제1 컨텍스트 데이터 및 제2 컨텍스트 데이터 중 적어도 하나의 컨텍스트 데이터를 식별하고, 협업과 관련된 기 설정된 태스크 할당 알고리즘에 식별된 적어도 하나의 컨텍스트 데이터를 입력하여 로봇에 대응되는 태스크 정보를 획득하고, 획득된 태스크 정보에 기초하여 구동부를 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for managing highway construction based on BIM technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of highway construction management, in particular to a method and a system for managing highway construction based on a BIM technology. The method and the system for managing the highway construction based on the BIM technology enhance the communication coordination of all parties, dynamically master the participation condition of each party of a project in real time, enhance the dynamic management of the process, interactively confirm through an informationized means, enhance the management standardization of the construction process, provide powerful and reliable guarantee for cost saving, enhance the responsibility consciousness, ensure that each transaction can be responsible for the person through each task allocation and task tracking, carry out a visual management mode, enhance the understanding of the participating parties on the project and reduce the communication cost.
assignees: GUIZHOU ZHONGZHI IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Product production management system based on two-level analysis
abstract_en: The application provides a product production management system based on two-level analysis, which comprises an MES system, wherein the MES system is used for acquiring production orders and production data of target products, carrying out automatic matching and logic operation according to the production orders and the production data, generating MES work order information and generating a product bar code according to the MES work order information, the production data comprises process basic information, a process route basic table, material main information, a process and material comparison information, and the MES work order information comprises order quantity, production date, process path information and process material BOM information. The product production management system based on the secondary analysis can build a product production management, product tracing and after-sales service system of a unified identification system based on the secondary analysis, realize resource sharing and service coordination, and provide data support for purchase optimization, intelligent manufacturing and large-scale customization modes.

title_en: Solution for scaling/reducing employing 5G image communication
title_ko: 5g영상통신을 이용한 영상 확대/축소 솔루션
abstract_en: An embodiment relates to an image enlargement/reduction solution using 5G image communication. Particularly, this solution is used for a 5G-based IoT device for mounting on an accident management vehicle. In addition, an embodiment relates to a 5G device-based two-way response image system technique between a control center and a command vehicle so that the control (command) center can grasp and respond to an on-site situation in real time when a disaster occurs in a bridge or a large bridge. In this case, an SR GAN-based deep learning-based image enlargement technique for centralized control is provided. Therefore, an embodiment secures a support technique capable of preventing secondary collisions and minimizing damage through recognition of traffic accidents, rapid determination according to accident types, and responses thereto. In the event of a collision, the control center can the collision and can support images to so that the collision is identified and the control center can cooperate with related organizations (fire department, police station, etc.). In addition, situations can be accurately transmitted and collisions can be handled by using image sharing, based on 5G new technology, in an accident handling communication system such as a radio and a wired/wireless telephone between the existing accident management vehicle and the control center. In addition, IP speakers are installed in each road facility section to support selective evacuation/announcement broadcast such as distance-specific bypass guidance, front-accident guidance, and warning broadcasting guidance around accident points, thereby providing convenience and smooth measures.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 5G영상통신을 이용한 영상 확대/축소 솔루션에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로, 이러한 솔루션은 사고관리차량 탑재용 5G 기반의 IoT 디바이스 장치에 사용하는 것이다. 그리고, 또한 교량 및 대교에서 재난, 재해 사고가 났을 경우, 상황을 관제(지휘) 센터에서 현장의 상황을 실시간으로 파악하고 대응할 수 있도록 5G 디바이스 기반의 관제 센터/ 지휘 차량 간 양방향 대응 영상체계 기술이다. 그리고, 이러한 경우에, 집중 관제를 위한 SR GAN 기반형 딥러닝 기반 영상확대 기술을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
따라서, 이를 통해 실시예는 교통사고에 대한 인지, 사고형태에 따른 신속한 판단과 대응을 통해 2차 추돌사고를 방지 및 피해 최소화할 수 있는 지원 기술확보를 제공한다. 
그리고, 충돌사고 발생 시, 관제 센터에서 이를 확인하고 유관기관(소방청, 경찰청 등)과 연계 협력이 이루어 질 수 있도록 영상 지원이 가능하다. 
또한, 기존 사고관리 차량과 관제 센터 간의 무전기, 유무선전화기 등 사고수습 의사교환 체계를 5G 신기술 기반 영상공유를 통해 정확한 상황 전달 가능 및 충돌사고 대처가 가능하다. 
이에 더하여, 또한 IP스피커를 통하여 도로시설물 구간별로 설치하고 사고지점을 중심으로 거리별 우회도로 안내, 전방 사고 안내, 경보방송 안내 등 선별 대피/안내방송 지원을 통해 편의와 원활하 조치를 제공한다.

title_en: Method for providing information gathering and sharing service using drone at diaster-affected site based on cooperation of citizen and government
title_ko: 민관공조 기반 드론을 이용한 현장정보 수급 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a method of providing an on-site information supply service using a public-private assistance drone. The method comprises: a step of storing civilian workforce information including information on at least one drone, at least one emergency operation terminal linked with the at least one drone, and a drone civilian expert to be mapped with a location; a step of classifying civilian workforce information by region to form a drone emergency operation team and assigning a site command terminal of a squad leader by region, who manages the drone emergency operation team; a step of determining whether the drone emergency management team operates based on disaster situation information collected from at least one public institution server; a step of sending a site dispatch order to the site command terminal if whether operation of the drone emergency management team is determined; a step of receiving a streamed video of at least one drone divided by a predetermined time unit from at least one emergency operation terminal; and a step of uploading the streamed video by mapping the same to a map to correspond to a location. According to the present invention, image information for a site situation and a damaged state can be rapidly received and the site situation can be quickly reported such that the site situation can be relayed and countermeasures can be suggested within a short time.
abstract_ko: 민관공조 기반 드론을 이용한 현장정보 수급 서비스 제공 방법이 제공되며, 적어도 하나의 드론, 적어도 하나의 드론과 연동되는 적어도 하나의 긴급운용단말, 및 드론 민간 전문가의 정보를 포함한 민간인력정보를 위치와 매핑되도록 저장하는 단계, 민간인력정보를 권역별로 분류하여 드론긴급운용팀을 구성하고, 드론긴급운용팀을 관리하는 비행단장의 현장 지휘소 단말을 지역별로 배정하는 단계, 적어도 하나의 공공기관 서버로부터 수집된 재난상황정보에 기반하여 드론긴급운용팀의 운영여부를 결정하는 단계, 드론긴급운용팀의 운영여부가 결정되는 경우, 현장 지휘소 단말로 현장출동명령을 전송하는 단계, 및 적어도 하나의 긴급운용단말로부터 적어도 하나의 드론의 촬영영상을 기 설정된 시간 단위로 나누어 스트리밍받는 단계, 및 스트리밍된 촬영영상을 위치에 대응되도록 지도에 매핑하여 업로드하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Trust level based task assignment in an online work management system
abstract_en: An online work management system provides a marketplace for multiple job owner and workers. The job owners provide a job description that defines task. The job description may be processed to generate task descriptions that may be published for workers' application. The task descriptions specify the qualification or restrictions for workers to have the task assigned. The online work management system also provides various functions supporting coordination and management of task assignment such as determining the trust level of the user's identity, search the tasks or workers, monitoring the progress of job, managing payment to workers, training and testing the workers, evaluating the review by the job owners, and generation of surveys.
assignees: ELENBAAS DANIEL J;KRISHNAN RAJESH;WEYL STEPHEN;NUDD GEOFFREY;CLEARSHIFT CORP

title_en: Gas pipeline-third party construction coupling hidden danger identification and management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas pipeline-third-party construction coupling hidden danger identification and management system, which comprises a third-party construction management module, a supervision coordination module, a hidden danger management module, a task management module and a data management module, wherein the third-party construction management module is used for acquiring and analyzing third-party construction information and finishing information interaction between a gas company and a third-party construction unit; the supervision coordination module is used for assigning work order personnel of the gas company to perform dispatching, routing inspection, special supervision and coordination tasks on the pipelines in the third-party construction range; the hidden danger management module is used for managing and analyzing hidden danger data in the third-party construction process; the task management module is used for managing and analyzing the third-party construction hidden danger processing data; the data management module is used for storing and processing system data; the invention has the advantages that: the intelligent interaction platform of the gas company and a third-party construction unit is provided, and the informatization level of third-party construction management and the identification and treatment strength of the third-party construction hidden danger are improved.

title_en: Secondary transfer system and method for fusing historical worksheets and job matching traffic complaints
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent work order processing, in particular to a system and a method for secondarily transferring traffic complaints by integrating historical work orders and functions, comprising an interface service layer, a processing layer and a processing layer, wherein the interface service layer is configured to receive work order requests and return transfer results to realize a null value fault tolerance mechanism, and the system is used for automatically replacing a work order title or call content with 'none' when the work order title or call content is null, and dynamically selecting final processing content based on the states of the title and the call content; the intelligent transferring engine dynamically prompts the engineering module, and has the beneficial effects that the dispatching accuracy is remarkably improved through a double verification mechanism, a verification basis is provided for historical work order experience, and department function matching ensures the correspondence of rights and responsibilities. In practical application, the accuracy rate of complex work order processing is improved to more than 93%, cross-department coordination errors are reduced by 70%, and the success rate of first dispatch of fuzzy complaints of responsibilities is improved to 89%.
assignees: INSPUR CLOUD INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart radioactive prevention system
title_ko: 스마트 방사능 방재 지휘 통제시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사능 누출사고 시, 현장, 민간업체, 유관기관, 행정기관 및 중앙정부와 긴밀하게 연동하여 경보, 대피유도, 피폭현황, 교통정보 및 영상 제공을 통해 통합적인 지휘 및 통제서비스를 제공으로써 신속하고 체계적인 대응 서비스를 제공하여 인명/재산피해를 최소화함과 동시에 비상대응절차 및 조치사항 수행을 효과적으로 지원하여 지휘 및 통제의 효율성을 극대화시킬 수 있고, 통합관제서버가 각 관련시스템을 관리 및 제어하는 컨트롤 타워 기능을 수행함으로써 종래에 방사능 누출 사고에 대한 각 관련시스템의 서로 다른 정보 및 대처방안 제공으로 인한 이재민의 혼란, 시간소모 등을 효과적으로 방지 및 절감시킬 수 있는 스마트 방사능 방재 지휘 통제시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for logistics distribution of supply chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics distribution management, and discloses an intelligent monitoring system for logistics distribution of a supply chain, which comprises a multidimensional monitoring module and an intelligent distribution module. The intelligent monitoring system for logistics distribution of the supply chain acquires management data of all work orders and distribution data of all logistics vehicles through the multi-dimensional monitoring module, and classifies the management data and the distribution data into a data set, the intelligent distribution module analyzes production estimated speed of each work order, finishes average processing speed of each processing flow, divides daily throughput, analyzes configuration quantity of each work order corresponding to the logistics vehicles according to different types of logistics vehicles, forms a corresponding distribution plan, flexibly plans the distribution plan, improves resource configuration efficiency, the intelligent distribution module analyzes transportation state of each logistics vehicle, generates monitoring data sets and distribution estimated time length, evaluates vehicle state in a mobile processing process and distribution state of the work orders, generates corresponding early warning signals, and has high dynamic management coordination efficiency.

title_en: Comprehensive management system for subway field section
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comprehensive management system for subway field segments, which comprises: a hardware framework for providing an operating hardware environment for managing the software units; and the work order management module is used for generating a maintenance work order corresponding to the to-be-processed fault work order task according to the on-duty condition and the specialty corresponding to the to-be-processed fault work order task when receiving the to-be-processed fault work order task for the subway field section, and sending the maintenance work order to the work order to enable the work order to dispatch according to the maintenance work order, so that the fault elimination of the to-be-processed fault work order task is completed. The system of the invention realizes the functions of fault work order management, maintenance plan management, on-duty management, user information management and statistical analysis, provides informationized means for the management of the secondary dispatching fault work order, reduces the use of paper work orders and plans, improves the information transmission speed, improves the fault maintenance efficiency, and has the high efficiency and coordination consistency of dispatching comprehensive management.

title_en: Simulation training and evaluation system for fire fighting activity on-scene command system
title_ko: 소방활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 및 평가 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulation training and evaluation system for a fire-fighting activity on-scene command system, which performs training, wherein an on-scene commander commands a fire-fighting activity for each fire type, through a simulation to evaluate and manage the same. According to the present invention, the simulation training and evaluation system for a fire-fighting activity on-scene command system, which enables a fire-fighting commander to perform the fire-fighting activity on-scene command system through a personal terminal and receive evaluation, includes: a scenario editing server (100) which edits a training scenario of a fire situation for each fire type to implement simulation training content, so that the on-scene commander can get education training through the personal terminal; a learning management system (LMS) server (200) which evaluates and manages a training result of the on-scene commander performing training through the personal terminal through the simulation training content implemented by the scenario editing server (100); and a training evaluation database server (300) which stores and manages data generated through the scenario editing server (100) and the LMS server (200). The LMS sever (200) is interconnected with the training evaluation database server (200) to be able to be interconnected with simulation training content for each fire type of the fire-fighting activity on-scene command system. Training content and user information are provided to be able to be modified and deleted through a web.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 현장지휘관이 화재유형별로 소방활동을 지휘하는 훈련을 시뮬레이션을 통해 수행하고 이를 평가하여 관리할 수 있도록 하는 소방활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 및 평가 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 소방활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 및 평가 시스템은 소방 지휘관이 개인 단말기를 통해 소방활동 현장지휘체계 훈련을 수행하고 평가받을 수 있도록 하는 소방활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 및 평가 시스템으로서,  
현장지휘관이 개인 단말기를 통해 교육 훈련을 할 수 있도록 화재유형별 화재상황의 훈련 시나리오를 편집하여 시뮬레이션 훈련 콘텐츠를 구현하는 시나리오 편집 서버(100)와; 상기 시나리오 편집 서버(100)에 의해 구현된 시뮬레이션 훈련 콘텐츠를 통하여 개인 단말기로 훈련을 수행하는 현장지휘관의 훈련 결과를 평가 관리하는 LMS(Learning Management System) 서버(200)와; 상기 시나리오 편집 서버(100) 및 LMS 서버(200)를 통하여 생성되는 데이터를 저장하고 관리하는 훈련 평가 데이터베이스 서버(300);를 포함하되, 상기 LMS 서버(200)는 훈련 평가 데이터베이스 서버(200)와 연동되어 화재유형별 소방 활동 현장지휘체계 시뮬레이션 훈련 콘텐츠와 연동이 가능하며, 훈련 내용 및 사용자 정보를 Web을 통해 조회 및 수정, 삭제할 수 있도록 제공된다.

title_en: A method of post purchase management for executing supply business in a shipyard
title_ko: 조선소의 조달업무상의 구매 사후관리 시스템 구축 방법
abstract_en: A method for constructing a post-purchase management system for supply business in a shipyard is provided to systemize a vendor development and estimation process, construct an information system for a vendor cooperation system, establish a quality and quality management process of material, and construct the information system for vendor record for estimating vendors. A work order schedule fixed in current work is inquired, and the fixed work order is mapped to a purchase order. The vendor checks the work order schedule. The vendor requests change of a delivery if adjustment of the delivery is required. A supply business part determines and fixes the delivery adjustment by responding to a delivery adjustment request. History from issuance of the purchase order and the delivery is inquired.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 조선소의 조달업무상의 구매 사후관리 시스템 구축 방법에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는, 본 발명은, 공급업체 개발 및 평가 프로세스를 체계화하고, 공급업체 협업 체계를 위한 정보시스템을 구축하며, 자재에 대한 품질 검사 및 품질 관리 프로세스를 정립하고, 공급업체 평가를 위한 업체 실적(예를 들면, 납기준수, 원가절감, 품질 등)에 대한 정보시스템을 구축할 수 있도록 하는 조선소의 조달업무상의 구매 사후관리 시스템 구축 방법에 관한 것이다. 
       
     조선소의 조달업무, 구매 사후관리

title_en: Property service data analysis method and system based on work order scheduling platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a property service data analysis method and system based on a work order scheduling platform. The property service data analysis method comprises the following steps: the property service system sends work order information generated by each task execution mechanism in task execution to a work order scheduling platform, and the work order scheduling platform combines a work order monitoring time period setting model to set and monitor a monitoring time period for work order information reception; after receiving the work order information, the work order scheduling platform analyzes and identifies the data of the work order information to obtain the task execution state of each task execution mechanism, calls the work order information required by the task execution mechanism to the corresponding task execution mechanism, and performs coordination scheduling on the task execution among the task execution mechanisms of the property service system; and visually displaying the coordination scheduling condition of the work order scheduling platform by using the IOC platform. The system comprises modules corresponding to the method steps.

title_en: Esi map service apparatus for hns spill response
title_ko: 위험유해물질 방제정보지도 제공 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for providing a hazard and noxious substance prevention and control information map, capable of efficiently preventing and controlling hazard and noxious substance (HNS) pollution accidents by setting a prior prevention and control target area in the case of leaked hazard and noxious substances by deriving an environmental sensitivity index map of a coastline based on the type, fractal dimension, and wave information of the coastline. The apparatus comprises: a prevention and control information map providing part interacting with a connected user through a prevention and control information map providing interface and providing a prevention and control information map; and a storage part storing a database for storing and providing information about command and contact systems, environment information, map and satellite image information, prevention and control guideline information, coastline information, sensitive resource information, prevention and control resource information, and material supply information to the prevention and control information map providing part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 해안선의 유형, 프랙탈 차원 및 파랑 정보를 통합하여 해안선의 환경민감도 지수를 도출하여 위험유해물질(HNS: Hazard and Noxious Substance)의 유출 시 우선 방제 대상 지역을 설정하여 방제를 수행할 수 있도록 하는 것에 의해 해양 HNS 오염 사고에 대한 효율적인 방제를 수행할 수 있도록 하는 위험유해물질 방제정보지도 제공 장치에 관한 것이다. 
접속된 사용자에게 방제정보지도제공 인터페이스를 제공하여 상호작용을 수행하며 방제정보지도를 제공하는 방제정보지도제공부; 및 방제정보지도 제작을 위한 지휘체계 및 연락처체계 정보와, 환경정보와, 지도 및 위성 영상 정보와, 방제지침정보와, 해안선정보와, 민감자원정보와, 방제자원정보와, 물자보급정보를 저장하여 방제정보지도제공부로 제공하는 데이터베이스를 저장하는 저장부;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Intelligent tower crane cooperative control system and method based on task tree model
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent tower crane cooperative control system and method based on a task tree model. The method allows the engineering operation to be issued in the mode of descriptive information such as natural language and work order tables, converts the descriptive information of the engineering operation into a temporal correlation sequence consisting of a series of operation tasks, combines the equipment state parameter information of the intelligent tower crane and the real-time perception information of a working scene, executes matching of the operation tasks, the equipment state and the working scene of the intelligent tower crane, and performs task tree decision and cooperative scheduling on the basis of the temporal correlation sequence, so that an instant operation instruction is issued to each intelligent tower crane in the intelligent tower crane cluster in an autonomous decision mode, conflicts in the aspects of space and material are avoided, and the coordination control and adjustment capacity of the intelligent tower crane cluster is enhanced.

title_en: Vehicle based device for task assignments and collaboration
abstract_en: Mobile device installed in a vehicle for communicating a current location and a current destination, to a coordination server, receives a set of tasks (statically assigned or dynamically assigned) for the user/driver, with automatic collaboration initiated with a second driver for task completion, and facilitating VR based user training, as required.

title_en: Interactive wireless life safety communications system
abstract_en: An interactive wireless life safety communications system is disclosed. A central coordination server is linked to a first network, over which there is a connection to at least one resident life safety device at a specific location or for specific resident. An alarm signal is generated by the resident life safety device upon detection of an alarm condition and transmitted to the central coordination server. A caregiver communications device is connected to the central coordination server over a second network, and is receptive to an alarm notification that is generated by the central coordination server in response to the alarm signal. The caregiver communications device is also receptive to a caregiver user input, from which an action status response is generated for transmission to the central coordination server.

title_en: Vehicle installed mobile device and server for GPS services and task assignments
abstract_en: Mobile device installed in a vehicle for communicating a current location and a current destination, to a coordination server, receiving a set of tasks (statically assigned or dynamically assigned) for the user (for example, from the server or from another user or adhoc tasks specified by a customer), displaying the set of tasks to the user, receiving a completion response (successful or unsuccessful) from the user, and proceeding to the next waypoint along a route/trip plan. A coordination server facilitates communication of a list of tasks dynamically and opportunistically assigned to a user to be performed at a specified location.

title_en: Welding work order dispatching method based on nuclear power safety production management platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear power weld joint management, and particularly relates to a welding work order dispatching method based on a nuclear power safety production management platform. The method comprises the following steps: s1: pushing a welding cooperation list to a welding management system through a nuclear power safety production management platform; s2: after receiving the welding coordination list, the welding management system initiates a welding application programming and a welding application submitting based on the welding coordination list; s3: preparing a welding file and generating a welding line welding work order; s4: after the preparation of the welding work order of the welding seam is completed, the welding task is dispatched; s5: after the welding task is executed, recording welding completion data; s6: the welding management system sends welding completion data to a nuclear power safety production management platform; s7: and the nuclear power safety production management platform performs the total record of the completed data. The beneficial effects are that: the existing nuclear power safety production management platform is fully utilized, and the development cost of a welding management system is saved.
assignees: CNNC NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Integrated support system of monitoring field, and methof thereof
title_ko: 현장 통합 지원 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 현장 통합 지원 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다. 여기서, 이 시스템은 이동하는 지역의 유해가스 농도를 측정하고, 측정한 유해가스 농도와 위치 정보를 실시간으로 전송하는 휴대형 유해가스 감지기, 상기 휴대형 유해가스 감지기로부터 상기 측정한 유해가스 농도 및 상기 위치 정보를 수신하고, 지리 정보 시스템(Geographic Information System, GIS)과 연동하여 상기 유해가스 농도와 상기 위치 정보를 매칭하여 오염 지역 지도를 생성하며, 현장지휘소 설치에 관한 지정 정보와 상기 오염 지역 지도를 기초로 상기 현장지휘소의 후보 위치를 생성하여 적어도 하나의 유관기관 서버 또는 유관기관 단말에게 전송하는 제어 장치, 그리고 상기 제어 장치와 유선 또는 무선으로 연결되어, 상기 오염 지역 지도 및 상기 후보 위치를 화면에 표시하는 스마트 상황판을 포함한다.

title_en: Multilevel assignment of jobs and tasks in online work management system
abstract_en: An online work management system provides a marketplace for multiple job owner and workers. The job owners provide a job description that defines task. The job description may be processed to generate task descriptions that may be published for workers' application. The task descriptions specify the qualification or restrictions for workers to have the task assigned. The online work management system also provides various functions supporting coordination and management of task assignment such as determining the trust level of the user's identity, search the tasks or workers, monitoring the progress of job, managing payment to workers, training and testing the workers, evaluating the review by the job owners, and generation of surveys.
assignees: WEYL STEPHEN;ELENBAAS DANIEL J;KRISHNAN RAJESH;CLEARSHIFT CORP

title_en: Smart radioactive prevention system
title_ko: 스마트 방사능 방재 지휘 통제시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart radioactivity prevention commanding and controlling system capable of minimizing life/property damage by providing an integrated commanding and controlling service through alerts, evacuation guidance, an exposure situation, traffic information, and image provision by closely linking a site, a private company, a related agency, an administrative agency, and central government in a radiation leakage accident; and maximizing command and control efficiency by effectively supporting an emergency response procedure and a corrective measure. Since an integrated control server performs a control tower function for managing and controlling each related system, the present invention effectively prevents and reduces confusion and time consumption of victims due to provision of different information and countermeasure of each related system for a conventional radiation leakage accident.

assignees: LODICS CO LTD;ULJU GUN ULSAN METROPOLITAN CITY

title_en: Multi-vehicle coordination-based vehicle scheduling system and method, electronic apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: A multi-vehicle coordination-based vehicle scheduling system and method, an electronic apparatus, and a storage medium. The scheduling system includes a parameter module configured for determining a scheduling parameter; a scheduling module configured for determining a scheduling result; a coordination module configured for determining a coordination impact value; a correction module configured for correcting the scheduling parameter, the correction module judging whether the coordination impact value is no less than a preset threshold, correcting the scheduling parameter based on a judgment result that the coordination impact value is no less than the preset threshold, and re-determining the scheduling result and the coordination impact value based on the corrected scheduling parameter; and an output module configured for outputting the scheduling result based on the judgment result that the coordination impact value is less than the preset threshold. Sequence order and task assignment problems when scheduling multiple vehicles are effectively solved.

title_en: Intelligent work order dynamic scheduling processing method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent work order dynamic scheduling processing method based on multi-source data fusion, which is characterized in that data fusion layers are used for collecting internet of things data, resource data and personnel data, an intelligent decision layer is used for analyzing the internet of things data in real time to create a pre-diagnosis work order or manually create a fault work order and submit the fault work order to the intelligent decision layer, when the work order enters a system, the intelligent decision layer calculates comprehensive scheduling scores for all maintenance personnel meeting the conditions, the work order is automatically distributed to the personnel with the highest scores and all information is pushed to a communication terminal of the maintenance personnel, warehouse inventory is automatically checked through a resource coordination layer while dispatching, and after maintenance is completed, the result and the time are recorded back to the system to form a self-learning closed loop. The invention changes from 'people looking for something' and 'people looking for something' to 'people looking for something' and 'things are good', is a fundamental innovation of operation and maintenance modes, can improve the average efficiency of people, reduce the cost and get rid of excessive dependence on personal experience.

abstract_en: Mobile device installed in a vehicle for communicating a current location and a current destination, to a coordination server, receives a set of tasks (statically assigned or dynamically assigned) for the user/driver, with automatic collaboration initiated with a second driver for task completion, and facilitating VR based user training, as required.

title_en: Construction progress control method in engineering supervision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction progress control method in engineering supervision, which comprises the steps of calculating current on-time completion rate and process handover delay time of each subcontractor according to a real-time progress data set and a pre-established engineering project network diagram, identifying progress fluctuation modes of different engineering stages through a time sequence analysis method, building a correlation model of the subcontractor and the engineering stages, dynamically adjusting a construction plan and a resource allocation scheme of each subcontractor according to a priority score by taking the minimum whole construction delay and the resource idling as objective functions and utilizing an optimization algorithm to generate an optimized project progress plan, wherein the optimized project progress plan comprises specific work arrangement and resource allocation suggestions of each subcontractor, analyzing a successful coordination strategy in a history project, recommending coordination measures and generating a set of communication matrixes for project managers according to the characteristics and progress conditions of the current project, and the coordination measures comprise resource allocation suggestions, process optimization schemes and communication strategy templates.

title_en: Interactive wireless life safety communications system
abstract_en: An interactive wireless life safety communications system is disclosed. A central coordination server is linked to a first network, over which there is a connection to at least one resident life safety device at a specific location or for specific resident. An alarm signal is generated by the resident life safety device upon detection of an alarm condition and transmitted to the central coordination server. A caregiver communications device is connected to the central coordination server over a second network, and is receptive to an alarm notification that is generated by the central coordination server in response to the alarm signal. The caregiver communications device is also receptive to a caregiver user input, from which an action status response is generated for transmission to the central coordination server.

title_en: Property service data analysis method and system based on work order scheduling platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a property service data analysis method and system based on a work order scheduling platform. The property service data analysis method comprises the following steps: the property service system sends work order information generated by each task execution mechanism in task execution to a work order scheduling platform, and the work order scheduling platform combines a work order monitoring time period setting model to set and monitor a monitoring time period for receiving the work order information; after receiving the work order information, the work order scheduling platform analyzes and identifies the data of the work order information to obtain the task execution state of each task execution mechanism, calls the work order information required by the task execution mechanism to the corresponding task execution mechanism, and performs coordinated scheduling on the task execution among the task execution mechanisms of the property service system; and visually displaying the coordination scheduling condition of the work order scheduling platform by using the IOC platform. The system comprises modules corresponding to the method steps.
assignees: RONGTONG REAL ESTATE PROPERTY MAN CO LTD

title_en: Tracking processing method and device for power grid infrastructure problems, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a tracking processing method, a device, computer equipment and a medium for a power grid infrastructure problem. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to a power grid infrastructure problem reported by a problem initiating node, forming a solution measure item aiming at the power grid infrastructure problem, and transmitting the solution measure item to at least one level of auditing node for item auditing; when an audit passing response matched with the solution item is detected, an electronic work order matched with the solution item is formed, and the electronic work order is issued to a matched responsible processing node for problem processing; and tracking and detecting at least one monitoring parameter in the electronic work order in real time, and executing a matched tracking processing strategy according to a tracking and detecting result. According to the embodiment of the invention, through the method, the problems of real-time statistics and tracking management of project information and problem conditions of the power grid infrastructure are solved, the improvement of working efficiency is realized, the reduction of error risks and the project problem coordination process control are realized.

title_en: Method of providing clothing producing matching and apparatus performing the same
title_ko: 의류 생산 매칭 및 협업 서비스 제공 서버 및 이를 실행하는 장치
abstract_en: A server for providing clothing production, matching, and collaboration services according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a database in which clothing production factory information received from a factory terminal is stored; a tag generation unit which generates a plurality of tags by using the clothing production factory information stored in the database; a weighted value allocation unit which, upon receiving a work order for a production target clothing from a client terminal, assigns a weighted value to a tag matching the information on the work order; and a factory matching unit which calculates the total weighted value for the corresponding factory by using the weighted value assigned to each tag of the factory identifier, extracts the corresponding factories based on the calculated total weighted value, and generates and provides a recommended factory list. Therefore, the server can match a client and a factory so that the client can produce clothing through a collaboration process when the client produces products via a factory.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 의류 생산 매칭 및 협업 서비스 제공 서버는 공장 단말로부터 수신된 의류 생산 공장 정보가 저장되어 있는 데이터베이스, 상기 데이터베이스에 저장되어 있는 의류 생산 공장 정보를 이용하여 복수의 태그를 생성하는 태그 생성부, 의뢰자 단말로부터 생산 대상 의류에 대한 작업 지시서를 수신하면, 상기 작업 지시서 상의 정보와 매칭되는 태그에 가중치를 할당하는 가중치 할당부 및 상기 공장 식별자 각각의 태그에 할당된 가중치를 이용하여 해당 공장의 전체 가중치를 산출하고, 상기 산출된 전체 가중치에 따라 해당 공장을 추출한 후 공장 추천 리스트를 생성하여 제공하는 공장 매칭부를 포함한다.

title_en: System and method of managing resources for calamity confrontation
title_ko: 재난대응 자원 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for managing resources for a calamity are provided to manage several related institutes, manpower, and equipment for the calamity site systematically by obviously checking activities of the related institutes. A system(100) for managing resources for a calamity inputted to one individual zone of the calamity site is composed of a check pointer(10) for checking retention information of the resources by wireless; an input unit(12) for inputting input information including input tasks for the resources; and a processing unit(14) for making and outputting situation information for the resources input to the corresponding individual zone on the basis of information inputted from the check pointer and the input unit. The retention information is recorded in an RFID(Radio Frequency Identification) tag(1) applied to the corresponding resources. The check pointer has an RFID reader for reading the retention information recorded in the RFID tag.
abstract_ko: 현장 또는 원격지의 지휘자가 재난 현장에 투입된 자원의 운영을 합리적으로 할 수 있고 투입된 다수의 유관기관의 활동을 일목요연하게 파악할 수 있도록 한 재난대응 자원 관리 시스템 및 방법을 제시한다. 제시된 재난대응 자원 관리 시스템은 재난현장의 어느 한 개별 구역에 투입되는 자원을 관리하는 재난대응 자원 관리 시스템으로서, 투입되는 자원이 가지고 있는 보유 정보를 무선으로 체크하는 체크 포인트기; 투입되는 자원에 대하여 투입임무를 포함한 투입 정보를 입력하는 입력부; 및 체크 포인트기 및 입력부로부터의 정보에 근거하여 해당하는 개별 구역에 투입되는 자원에 대한 현황 정보를 만들어 출력하는 처리부를 포함한다. 이러한 본 발명에 의하면, 재난현장의 인적·물적 투입자원의 현황을 현장 및 원격지의 상황실의 수준별 지휘자가 전술적 및 전략적으로 판단할 수 있도록 데이터베이스화하고 단계적으로 연산 가공하여 제공해 줌으로써, 지휘자가 투입자원의 운영을 합리적으로 할 수 있고 투입자원의 희생을 보다 적극적으로 막을 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue simulation system and its development platform
abstract_en: A maritime search and rescue simulation system mainly comprises a trainer station, a main ship, a plurality of auxiliary ships, a rescue helicopter unit and a video monitoring system. The trainer station is a command and control center of the development platform of the maritime search and rescue simulation system, and mainly used for completing the responsibilities of a search and rescue coordination center and an alarm station, undertaking management and controlling the function of the whole maritime search and rescue simulation development platform; the main ship simulates the function of the ships in distress or search and rescue ships, and carries out search and rescue actions under the command and the coordination of the trainer station; the auxiliary ships are set to the ships in distress or the search and rescue ships according to the requirements of search and rescue exercises and provided with stereographic projection visual systems of a viewing angle of 180 degrees; the rescue helicopter unit simulates maritime search and rescue helicopters and carries out the search and rescue actions in conjunction with the main ship and the auxiliary ships under the command and the coordination of the trainer station; and the video monitoring system is mainly used for achieving the visual transmission function of video information of search and rescue sites. The invention has the advantage that the platform support is provided for researching the maritime search and rescue simulation system.

title_en: Distribution time determining system and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a distribution time determining system and equipment. The system comprises: the distribution terminal is used for sending the time of the second task of the first distribution object to the dispatching center; the first delivery vehicle and the second delivery vehicle are respectively used for sending the time of the fourth task of the first delivery vehicle and the time of the sixth task of the second delivery vehicle to the dispatching center; a dispatch center for determining a time of a first handover task based on the times of the second and fourth tasks, and determining a time of a second handover task based on the times of the first handover task and the sixth task; the distribution terminal is used for determining the time of the first task based on the time of the second handover task; the first delivery vehicle and the second delivery vehicle are configured to determine times of a third task and a fifth task based on times of the first handoff task and the second handoff task, respectively. Compared with a mode of neglecting the time of the first handover task, the time of the second handover task is determined based on the time of the first handover task, and the accuracy of the obtained time is higher.

abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a tracking processing method and device for a power grid infrastructure problem, computer equipment and a medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: responding to the power grid infrastructure problem reported by the problem initiating node, forming a solution item aiming at the power grid infrastructure problem, and sending the solution item to at least one level of auditing nodes for item auditing; when an examination passing response matched with the solution item is detected, forming an electronic work order matched with the solution item, and sending the electronic work order to a matched responsible processing node for problem processing; and tracking and detecting at least one monitoring parameter in the electronic work order in real time, and executing a matched tracking processing strategy according to a tracking detection result. title_en: Systematic Outage Planning and Coordination in a Distribution Grid
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system and method for automated outage and work-flow planning system in a distributed electrical power grid with planned de-energization of electrical equipment as opposed to responding to an unplanned power outage. An automated system provides core conflict resolution and power outage planning. The present invention automatically notifies requestors of upcoming work orders. In addition, the present invention reduces scheduling in efficiencies by requiring requestors to confirm, to decline, or to edit on the fly their pending work order(s). The system also determines if all the orders are not completed and places the order back on the calendar for another day.

title_en: Integrated support system of monitoring field, and methof thereof
title_ko: 현장 통합 지원 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an integrated field support system and a method thereof which select an optimal location to secure safety of a field command post. The system comprises: a portable harmful gas sensor to measure a moving regional harmful gas concentration, and transmit a measured harmful gas concentration and location information in real-time; a control device to receive the measured harmful gas concentration and the location information from the portable harmful gas sensor, match the harmful gas concentration and the location information by linking to a geographic information system (GIS) to generate a contamination region map, and generate a candidate location of a field command post based on the contamination region map and designation information related to installation of the field command post to transmit the candidate location to at least one related organization server or related organization terminal; and a smart situation board connected to the control device in a wired or a wireless manner to display the contamination region map and the candidate location on a screen.
abstract_ko: 현장 통합 지원 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다. 여기서, 이 시스템은 이동하는 지역의 유해가스 농도를 측정하고, 측정한 유해가스 농도와 위치 정보를 실시간으로 전송하는 휴대형 유해가스 감지기, 상기 휴대형 유해가스 감지기로부터 상기 측정한 유해가스 농도 및 상기 위치 정보를 수신하고, 지리 정보 시스템(Geographic Information System, GIS)과 연동하여 상기 유해가스 농도와 상기 위치 정보를 매칭하여 오염 지역 지도를 생성하며, 현장지휘소 설치에 관한 지정 정보와 상기 오염 지역 지도를 기초로 상기 현장지휘소의 후보 위치를 생성하여 적어도 하나의 유관기관 서버 또는 유관기관 단말에게 전송하는 제어 장치, 그리고 상기 제어 장치와 유선 또는 무선으로 연결되어, 상기 오염 지역 지도 및 상기 후보 위치를 화면에 표시하는 스마트 상황판을 포함한다.
assignees: TAN SAN ELECTRONICS;UNIV HOSEO ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Robot and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 로봇 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: A robot is disclosed. The robot includes a sensor, a driving unit, a communication interface, and a processor. The processor acquires first context data through the sensor, receives second context data acquired by at least one other robot through the communication interface, identifies at least one of the first context data and the second context data based on a collaboration scenario between the robot and the other robot, obtains task information corresponding to the robot by inputting the identified at least one context data to a preset task assignment algorithm related to collaboration, and controls the driving unit based on the obtained task information. Accordingly, since a plurality of robots can receive tasks necessary for collaboration between the plurality of robots and provide services without the intervention of a management server, user convenience can be improved.
abstract_ko: 로봇이 개시된다. 로봇은 센서, 구동부, 통신 인터페이스 및 프로세서를 포함한다. 프로세서는 센서를 통해 제1 컨텍스트(context) 데이터를 획득하고, 적어도 하나의 타 로봇에 의해 획득된 제2 컨텍스트 데이터를 통신 인터페이스를 통해 수신하고, 로봇 및 타 로봇의 협업 시나리오에 기초하여 제1 컨텍스트 데이터 및 제2 컨텍스트 데이터 중 적어도 하나의 컨텍스트 데이터를 식별하고, 협업과 관련된 기 설정된 태스크 할당 알고리즘에 식별된 적어도 하나의 컨텍스트 데이터를 입력하여 로봇에 대응되는 태스크 정보를 획득하고, 획득된 태스크 정보에 기초하여 구동부를 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: Data analysis system and method for intelligent community service platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of community service platform management, in particular to a data analysis system and a method for an intelligent community service platform, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a platform data acquisition module, a target screening module to be coordinated, a maintenance progress analysis module and a work order coordination planning module, wherein equipment maintenance reservation data and equipment maintenance work order receiving data on a community service platform are acquired through the platform data acquisition module, maintenance delay risk coefficients of maintenance personnel are analyzed through the target screening module to be coordinated, maintenance work order to be coordinated targets are primarily screened out, a maintenance progress prediction model is established through the maintenance progress analysis module, maintenance conditions of the primarily screened maintenance work order to be coordinated targets are predicted, final maintenance work order to be coordinated targets are screened out through the work order coordination planning module, and prompt and coordination are carried out on maintenance work orders received by the screened targets, so that living equipment use problems of community residents are helped to be solved timely.
assignees: JINGJIANG DONGSHENG ASSET MAN CO LTD

title_en: Multi-vehicle coordination-based vehicle scheduling system, method, electronic apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: A multi-vehicle coordination-based vehicle scheduling system and method, an electronic apparatus, and a storage medium. The scheduling system includes a parameter module (310) configured for determining a scheduling parameter; a scheduling module (320) configured for determining a scheduling result; a coordination module (330) configured for determining a coordination impact value; a correction module (340) configured for correcting the scheduling parameter, the correction module judging whether the coordination impact value is no less than a preset threshold, correcting the scheduling parameter based on a judgment result that the coordination impact value is no less than the preset threshold, and re-determining the scheduling result and the coordination impact value based on the corrected scheduling parameter; and an output module (350) configured for outputting the scheduling result based on the judgment result that the coordination impact value is less than the preset threshold. Sequence order and task assignment problems when scheduling multiple vehicles are effectively solved, and problems of multi-vehicle conflict, congestion and impractical arrangement caused by multi-vehicle operation are perfected and solved, thus effectively improving the completion efficiency of transportation tasks.

title_en: Administrative affair management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an administrative affair management system, which comprises a leave management system comprising leave types of official travel examined and approved leaves and national ruled leaves, a comprehensive management system which comprises examination and approval items such as official reception, use of official vehicles, object purchase, vehicle maintenance, consumable supply, rejection, breakage and the like, and circulation items, such as work instruction report, department work coordination, leadership task assignment, and is provided with a leadership mail box function for receiving different opinions and views at any time and accepting good advices, and a charge management system comprising China Taxation Administration Information System (CTAIS) authority adjustment, case transfer, 'four small ticket' checking, manager working paper and application examination and approval items. The invention provides a quick and effective platform, so that requirements of 'efficiency, convenience, standardization and conversation' on administrative affairs are met.
